title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 16 · Biography of Du Shu, son of Du Ji · with Meng Kang, Yue Xiang

text.en: During the Taihe era Du Shu served Cao Rui as Cavalier Attendant Gentleman and Attendant Gentleman within the Yellow Gates; Cao Rui, considering him the son of a great minister, promoted him despite his lack of early reputation.
text.zht: 太和年間杜恕侍奉曹叡，任散騎侍郎、黃門侍郎；曹叡因他是大臣之子而加以提拔，雖然他早年並無聲名。
text.zhs: 太和年间杜恕侍奉曹叡，任散骑侍郎、黄门侍郎；曹叡因他是大臣之子而加以提拔，虽然他早年并无声名。

title.en: Attendant Gentleman within the Yellow Gates

text.en: For eight years at court, Du Shu submitted uncompromising and forthright memorials on economy, official assessment and the ruler's use of ministers.
text.zht: 杜恕在朝八年，屢次上疏直言，論財用、考課及君主用臣之道，無所迴避。
text.zhs: 杜恕在朝八年，屡次上疏直言，论财用、考课及君主用臣之道，无所回避。

text.en: Because he would not conform to his contemporaries' ways, Du Shu was repeatedly sent out of the capital, as Grand Administrator of Hongnong and Hedong, Protector of the Provincial Army north of the Huai, and Inspector of You Province with the Imperial Tally.
text.zht: 杜恕在朝不肯隨俗，屢被外放，歷任弘農太守、河東太守、淮北都督護軍，後出任幽州刺史，持節，領護烏丸校尉。
text.zhs: 杜恕在朝不肯随俗，屡被外放，历任弘农太守、河东太守、淮北都督护军，后出任幽州刺史，持节，领护乌丸校尉。

text.en: Du Shu and Li Feng had been close since childhood, but as adults their aims diverged sharply: Li Feng assiduously cultivated his reputation while Du Shu was unrestrained, and Li Feng regarded Du Shu with hostility, rising at court while Du Shu stayed at home; they later served together at court.
text.zht: 杜恕與李豐自幼親近，成年後志趣迥異：李豐刻意修飾名聲，杜恕則不拘小節，李豐因此敵視杜恕；李豐在朝中顯達時杜恕仍閒居在家，後來二人同朝為官。
text.zhs: 杜恕与李丰自幼亲近，成年后志趣迥异：李丰刻意修饰名声，杜恕则不拘小节，李丰因此敌视杜恕；李丰在朝中显达时杜恕仍闲居在家，后来二人同朝为官。

text.en: Because Du Shu cultivated no private connections and spoke forthrightly for the public good, Palace Attendant Xin Pi and others held him in high regard.
text.zht: 杜恕在朝不結私黨、一心為公，敢於直言，侍中辛毗等人因此十分敬重他。
text.zhs: 杜恕在朝不结私党、一心为公，敢于直言，侍中辛毗等人因此十分敬重他。

text.en: Du Shu objected to giving Lü Zhao, General Who Garrisons the North, charge of Ji Province as well, arguing that a man of his abilities could readily be replaced and that civil and military offices should be separate.
text.zht: 杜恕反對讓鎮北將軍呂昭兼領冀州，認為以他的才幹不難另擇他人，並主張文武分職。
text.zhs: 杜恕反对让镇北将军吕昭兼领冀州，认为以他的才干不难另择他人，并主张文武分职。

text.en: Yuan Kan, a Gentleman within the Yellow Gates, was Du Shu's colleague and close friend, and later warned him to be careful in dealing with Cheng Xi, which Du Shu ignored.
text.zht: 黃門侍郎袁侃是杜恕的同僚與摯友，後來曾勸他謹慎對待程喜，杜恕卻不以為意。
text.zhs: 黄门侍郎袁侃是杜恕的同僚与挚友，后来曾劝他谨慎对待程喜，杜恕却不以为意。

text.en: Xun Yu, later Grand Administrator of Dong Commandery, was Du Shu's colleague and close friend.
text.zht: 荀俁是杜恕的同僚與摯友，後任東郡太守。
text.zhs: 荀俁是杜恕的同僚与挚友，后任东郡太守。

text.en: Imperial Secretariat Gentleman Lian Zhao submitted a memorial accusing Cao Fan, the Imperial Secretariat Left Assistant, of imposing punishments contrary to imperial edicts, and Cao Fan was tried and questioned.
text.zht: 尚書郎廉昭上奏彈劾尚書左丞曹璠用刑違背詔令，曹璠因此受到審訊。
text.zhs: 尚书郎廉昭上奏弹劾尚书左丞曹璠用刑违背诏令，曹璠因此受到审讯。

text.en: Lian Zhao's accusation drew in the Director of the Imperial Secretariat, Chen Jiao, who submitted a memorial declaring he dared not evade punishment nor impose heavy penalties.
text.zht: 廉昭的彈劾牽涉尚書令陳矯，陳矯上奏表示不敢逃避責罰，也不敢加重處罰。
text.zhs: 廉昭的弹劾牵涉尚书令陈矫，陈矫上奏表示不敢逃避责罚，也不敢加重处罚。

text.en: Du Shu submitted a memorial remonstrating strongly against Lian Zhao, an outspoken official promoted for his abilities, urging the emperor not to let men like him sow confusion among the great ministers.
text.zht: 杜恕上疏強烈諫止，批評因才幹受提拔的廉昭好評議時事，請求皇帝勿讓此類人攪亂大臣。
text.zhs: 杜恕上疏强烈谏止，批评因才干受提拔的廉昭好评议时事，请求皇帝勿让此类人搅乱大臣。

text.en: Kong Xian, Colonel of the Capital, recruited the Grand General Sima Yi's arrogant and unruly younger brother Sima Tong, and the responsible officials stayed silent; Du Shu cited this as worse than yielding to private solicitation.
text.zht: 司隸校尉孔羨辟用大將軍司馬懿驕縱不羈的弟弟司馬通，有司緘口不言；杜恕認為此事比順從私托更為惡劣。
text.zhs: 司隶校尉孔羡辟用大将军司马懿骄纵不羁的弟弟司马通，有司缄口不言；杜恕认为此事比顺从私托更为恶劣。

text.en: A note identifies Sima Tong as King Xuan's fifth younger brother, an aide to the Colonel of the Capital.
text.zht: 注稱司馬通為宣王司馬懿的五弟，曾任司隸校尉屬官。
text.zhs: 注称司马通为宣王司马懿的五弟，曾任司隶校尉属官。

text.en: Sima Tong's son Sima Shun was enfeoffed as Neighbourhood Marquis of Longyang, but when Jin accepted Wei's abdication he refused to recognise the new mandate and was stripped of his title and exiled to Wuwei.
text.zht: 司馬通之子司馬順封隆陽亭侯，晉受魏禪時他拒不承認天命，被削爵流放武威。
text.zhs: 司马通之子司马顺封隆阳亭侯，晋受魏禅时他拒不承认天命，被削爵流放武威。

text.en: When Du Shu was transferred from Hongnong, Meng Kang succeeded him as Grand Administrator, governing with integrity, frugality and benevolence that won the praise of officials and people.
text.zht: 杜恕自弘農調任後，孟康繼任太守，為政清廉簡樸、仁厚有方，官民稱頌。
text.zhs: 杜恕自弘农调任后，孟康继任太守，为政清廉简朴、仁厚有方，官民称颂。

text.en: After Du Shu's provincial authorities executed a young attendant of a Xianbei chieftain's son without a memorial, Cheng Xi, General Who Conquers the North, impeached him; Du Shu was sentenced to death, then pardoned for his father's sake, reduced to commoner status and exiled to Zhangwu.
text.zht: 鮮卑首領之子的隨從被幽州官府未經上奏擅自處死，北征將軍程喜彈劾杜恕，杜恕被判死罪，因其父杜畿殉職之功獲赦，廢為庶人，流放章武郡。
text.zhs: 鲜卑首领之子的随从被幽州官府未经上奏擅自处死，北征将军程喜弹劾杜恕，杜恕被判死罪，因其父杜畿殉职之功获赦，废为庶人，流放章武郡。

text.en: Cheng Xi had wanted Du Shu to humble himself and apologise, and when Du Shu refused he drew up a harsh indictment against him.
text.zht: 程喜本想讓杜恕低頭謝罪，杜恕不從，他便寫下措辭嚴厲的彈劾文書。
text.zhs: 程喜本想让杜恕低头谢罪，杜恕不从，他便写下措辞严厉的弹劾文书。

text.en: Major Song Quan conveyed Cheng Xi's wish that Du Shu apologise.
text.zht: 軍司馬宋權轉達了程喜希望杜恕謝罪的意思。
text.zhs: 军司马宋权转达了程喜希望杜恕谢罪的意思。

text.en: Du Shu replied to Song Quan in a letter explaining that he acted on his own convictions and would bear the consequences himself, whether or not Cheng Xi understood.
text.zht: 杜恕致書宋權，說明自己依己見行事，無論程喜是否理解，後果皆由自己承擔。
text.zhs: 杜恕致书宋权，说明自己依己见行事，无论程喜是否理解，后果皆由自己承担。

text.en: When both were recalled and stood before the Commandant of Justice, Ruan Wu counselled Du Shu that he had talent but lacked firmness and singleness of purpose, and urged him to use his leisure to set forth a teaching of his own; Du Shu then wrote the Discourse on Fundamentals in exile.
text.zht: 二人同被召至廷尉，阮武勸告杜恕有才而少堅定、專一，請他利用閒暇著書立說；杜恕在流放期間遂作《體論》。
text.zhs: 二人同被召至廷尉，阮武劝告杜恕有才而少坚定、专一，请他利用闲暇著书立说；杜恕在流放期间遂作《体论》。

text.en: In the second year of Ganlu, Yue Xiang's memorial on Du Ji's achievements moved the court to enfeoff Du Shu's son Du Yu as Neighbourhood Marquis of Fengle.
text.zht: 甘露二年，樂詳上表陳述杜畿的功績，朝廷感動，封杜恕之子杜預為豐樂亭侯。
text.zhs: 甘露二年，乐详上表陈述杜畿的功绩，朝廷感动，封杜恕之子杜预为丰乐亭侯。

text.en: Du Yu's son Du Xi, courtesy name Shigu, served as Imperial Secretariat Left Assistant.
text.zht: 杜預之子杜錫，字世嘏，官至尚書左丞。
text.zhs: 杜预之子杜锡，字世嘏，官至尚书左丞。

text.en: Du Yu was Sima Yi's son-in-law, and later rendered distinguished service to the house of Jin.
text.zht: 杜預是司馬懿的女婿，後來為晉室立下殊勳。
text.zhs: 杜预是司马懿的女婿，后来为晋室立下殊勋。

text.en: Du Ji's son Du Li, courtesy name Wuzhong, was keenly perceptive but died aged twenty-one.
text.zht: 杜畿之子杜理，字務仲，敏銳有識，二十一歲去世。
text.zhs: 杜畿之子杜理，字务仲，敏锐有识，二十一岁去世。

text.en: Du Ji's son Du Kuan, courtesy name Wushu, was a learned, withdrawn scholar who died aged forty-two.
text.zht: 杜畿之子杜寬，字務叔，博學淡泊，四十二歲去世。
text.zhs: 杜畿之子杜宽，字务叔，博学淡泊，四十二岁去世。

text.en: Yue Xiang travelled on foot from Nanyang to seek out Xie Gai, who was well versed in the Zuo Tradition, and had his doubts and difficulties resolved.
text.zht: 樂詳聞知南郡謝該精通《左傳》，徒步自南陽前往拜訪，請教疑難，得其解答。
text.zhs: 乐详闻知南郡谢该精通《左传》，徒步自南阳前往拜访，请教疑难，得其解答。

text.en: Du Wu, Du Yu's elder cousin, served as Gentleman within the Yellow Gates but was unjustly executed by Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao.
text.zht: 杜預的堂兄杜武官至黃門侍郎，卻被趙王司馬倫冤殺。
text.zhs: 杜预的堂兄杜武官至黄门侍郎，却被赵王司马伦冤杀。

text.en: Ruan Wu's younger brother Ruan Bing, courtesy name Shuwen, served as Intendant of Henan and compiled a volume of prescriptions.
text.zht: 阮武之弟阮炳，字叔文，官至河南尹，並編有醫方一卷。
text.zhs: 阮武之弟阮炳，字叔文，官至河南尹，并编有医方一卷。

text.en: Ruan Bing's son Ruan Tan, courtesy name Hongshu, served under Jin as Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince and General Who Subdues the East.
text.zht: 阮炳之子阮坦，字弘舒，仕晉官至太子少傅、征東將軍。
text.zhs: 阮炳之子阮坦，字弘舒，仕晋官至太子少傅、征东将军。

text.en: Ruan Tan's younger brother Ruan Ke, courtesy name Shidu, ended up inheriting the fief that Ruan Tan felt should have been his.
text.zht: 阮坦之弟阮柯，字士度，最終繼承了阮坦自認應由自己承襲的封爵。
text.zhs: 阮坦之弟阮柯，字士度，最终继承了阮坦自认应由自己承袭的封爵。

text.en: Ruan Wu's father Ruan Chen, courtesy name Shixin, declined every summons and compiled the Illustrations of the Three Rites.
text.zht: 阮武之父阮諶，字士信，屢召不仕，撰有《三禮圖》。
text.zhs: 阮武之父阮谌，字士信，屡召不仕，撰有《三礼图》。

text.en: Lü Zhao's eldest son Lü Xun served on the Chancellor's staff and enjoyed Sima Zhao's favour.
text.zht: 呂昭長子呂巽任相國掾屬，受司馬昭寵信。
text.zhs: 吕昭长子吕巽任相国掾属，受司马昭宠信。

text.en: Lü Zhao's second son Lü An was a close friend of Ji Kang and was executed with him.
text.zht: 呂昭次子呂安與嵇康交好，與他一同被殺。
text.zhs: 吕昭次子吕安与嵇康交好，与他一同被杀。

text.en: Lü Zhao's son Lü Cui, courtesy name Jiti, served as Intendant of Henan.
text.zht: 呂昭之子呂粹，字季悌，官至河南尹。
text.zhs: 吕昭之子吕粹，字季悌，官至河南尹。

text.en: Lü Cui's son Lü Yu, courtesy name Jingyu, served as Deputy Imperial Censor.
text.zht: 呂粹之子呂預，字景虞，官至御史中丞。
text.zhs: 吕粹之子吕预，字景虞，官至御史中丞。

text.en: Lü An was a close friend of Ji Kang and was executed together with him.
text.zht: 呂安與嵇康交厚，二人一同被殺。
text.zhs: 吕安与嵇康交厚，二人一同被杀。

passages.en: Du Shu, courtesy name Wubo, served during the Taihe era as a [[Cavalier Attendant Gentleman|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-016]] and [[Attendant Gentleman within the Yellow Gates|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]. Sincere and straightforward, he did not put on appearances, and in his youth had no reputation. When at court, Du Shu cultivated no private connections, but devoted himself wholly to the public good. Whenever discussing the merits and faults of government policy, he appealed to the principles of the state and spoke forthrightly to set matters right. [[Palace Attendant|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]] Xin Pi and others therefore held him in high regard. At the time, the excellencies and ministers below them held a wide-ranging debate on administrative reforms. Du Shu argued: "The [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]s of old proclaimed and enforced the Six Articles. They were renowned for governing with restraint and tranquillity and for the authority they commanded. Inspectors today should not be permitted to command troops, so that they may devote themselves to only civil affairs." Soon afterwards, Lü Zhao, [[General Who Garrisons the North|/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-071]], was also [[concurrently|/translations/officials#glossary-concurrently-oversee]] given charge of [[Ji Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]. vern.zht: 《杜氏新書》記載：杜恕年少時和[[馮翊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=151]]人李豐都因爲父親的恩蔭而任職，童年時就關係很好。等到各自長大成人，李豐磨鍊自己的名聲和品行，以此來求取世人的讚譽，而杜恕不受拘束、率性而爲，和李豐的志趣完全不同。李豐最終名噪一時，京城的士人大多爲他四處宣揚，而也有些掌權的大臣認爲李豐的名聲超過了他的實際才能，而杜恕則是穿着粗布衣服卻懷揣美玉。因此杜開始不爲李豐所喜，杜恕也順其自然，不勉強自己去迎合時世。李豐在朝廷擔任顯要官職，杜恕卻依然在家中安閒自若。明帝因爲杜恕是大臣的兒子，提拔他擔任[[散騎侍郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-016]]，幾個月後，又轉任補授[[黃門侍郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]]。

annotations.en: The Du Shi Xinshu / New Book of Du Clan states: In their youth, Du Shu and Li Feng of [[Pingyi|/maps/map-overall?admin=151]] both received appointments on account of their fathers, and had been close since childhood. As they reached adulthood, Li Feng assiduously cultivated his reputation and conduct to win public acclaim, whereas Du Shu was unrestrained in manner and forthright in his actions. Their aspirations thus diverged sharply. Li Feng ultimately did win fame in his day, and many gentlemen in the capital praised and recommended him. Yet some among those in power considered Li Feng's fame greater than his substance, while Du Shu wore coarse cloth but harboured jade within. Li Feng therefore regarded him with hostility. Du Shu continued to follow his own nature and made no effort to conform to the times. When Li Feng rose to prominent positions at court, Du Shu was still at home without office, unperturbed. Cao Rui (posthumously honoured as Emperor Ming, the Radiant Emperor), considering Du Shu the son of a great minister, promoted him and [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] him [[Cavalier Attendant Gentleman|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-016]]. Several months later, he was [[transferred|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] to the post of [[Attendant Gentleman within the Yellow Gates|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-003]].

orig.zht: 「帝王之道，莫尚乎安民；安民之術，在於豐財。豐財者，務本而節用也。方今二賊未滅。戎車亟駕，此自熊虎之士展力之秋也。然搢紳之儒，橫加榮慕，搤腕抗論，以孫、吳為首，州郡[[牧|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]][[守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，咸共忽恤民之術，脩將率之事。農桑之民，競干戈之業，不可謂務本。帑藏歲虛而制度歲廣，民力歲衰而賦役歲興，不可謂節用。
orig.zhs: 「帝王之道，莫尚乎安民；安民之术，在于丰财。丰财者，务本而节用也。方今二贼未灭。戎车亟驾，此自熊虎之士展力之秋也。然搢绅之儒，横加荣慕，搤腕抗论，以孙、吴为首，州郡[[牧|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]][[守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，咸共忽恤民之术，修将率之事。农桑之民，竞干戈之业，不可谓务本。帑藏岁虚而制度岁广，民力岁衰而赋役岁兴，不可谓节用。

vern.zht: 帝王治理天下的道理，沒有比安定百姓更重要的；安定百姓的辦法，在於使財富豐足。使財富豐足，在於以農爲本、節省用度。如今吳、蜀二賊尚未消滅，戰車頻繁出動，這正是熊虎一般的勇士施展勇力的時候。然而士大夫們卻毫無道理地追慕榮耀，扼腕高談闊論，把孫武、吳起奉爲第一等人物；州[[牧|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]、郡[[守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]全都忽視撫卹百姓的辦法，而去講習將帥統兵之事。種田養蠶的百姓爭着從事戰爭之事，不能說是以農爲本。國庫一年比一年空虛，制度卻一年比一年繁多；民力一年比一年衰弱，賦稅徭役卻一年比一年增多，不能說是節省用度。
vern.zhs: 帝王治理天下的道理，没有比安定百姓更重要的；安定百姓的办法，在于使财富丰足。使财富丰足，在于以农为本、节省用度。如今吴、蜀二贼尚未消灭，战车频繁出动，这正是熊虎一般的勇士施展勇力的时候。然而士大夫们却毫无道理地追慕荣耀，扼腕高谈阔论，把孙武、吴起奉为第一等人物；州[[牧|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]、郡[[守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]全都忽视抚恤百姓的办法，而去讲习将帅统兵之事。种田养蚕的百姓争着从事战争之事，不能说是以农为本。国库一年比一年空虚，制度却一年比一年繁多；民力一年比一年衰弱，赋税徭役却一年比一年增多，不能说是节省用度。

passages.en: "The Way of emperors and kings holds nothing higher than bringing peace to the people. The means of doing so lie in increasing wealth, and wealth is increased by strengthening foundations and curbing expenditure. At present, the two rebels have yet to be destroyed, and the war chariots are repeatedly put in motion. This is indeed the time for warriors fierce as bears and tigers to exert their strength. Yet even our robed scholars rashly aspire to martial glory, clasping their wrists and declaiming, with Sun Wu and Wu Qi as their foremost models. [[Governor|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]s and [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]s throughout the provinces and commanderies neglect the art of caring for the people and apply themselves instead to the business of generals. Those who should till the fields and tend silkworms turn instead to the pursuit of arms. This cannot be called fostering the foundations of livelihood. The treasury is depleted year by year while official establishments continue to expand; the people's strength declines year by year while taxes and corvée multiply. This cannot be called curbing expenditure.

orig.zht: 今大魏奄有十州之地，而承喪亂之弊，計其戶口不如往昔一州之民，然而二方僭逆，北虜未賔，三邊遘難，繞天略帀；所以統一州之民，經營九州之地，其為艱難，譬策羸馬以取道里，豈可不加意愛惜其力哉？以武皇帝之節儉，府藏充實，猶不能十州擁兵；郡且二十也。今[[荊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]、[[揚|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=9]]、[[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]、[[幽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=15]]、[[并|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=0]]、[[雍|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=14]]、[[涼|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=5]]緣邊諸州皆有兵矣，其所恃內充府庫外制四夷者，惟[[兖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]、[[豫|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=16]]、[[司|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=7]]、[[兾|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]而已。

vern.zht: 如今大魏擁有十州的土地，卻承接了喪亂之後的凋敝，統計戶口還不如過去一州的民戶多。然而兩方僭越叛逆，北方胡人尚未歸順，三面邊境都遭受禍難，幾乎把天下環繞了一週。因此，要用相當於過去一州的民力去經營九州的土地，這種艱難就好比鞭策瘦弱的馬去趕遠路，怎麼能不格外愛惜它的力氣呢！即使憑武皇帝的節儉和府藏的充實，尚且不能讓十州和將近二十個郡都擁有軍隊。如今[[荊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=2]]、[[揚|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=9]]、[[青|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]、[[徐|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=8]]、[[幽|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=15]]、[[並|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=0]]、[[雍|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=14]]、[[涼|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=5]]這些沿邊各州都已經有了軍隊，而所依靠來對內充實府庫、對外製服四夷的，只有[[兗|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]、[[豫|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=16]]、[[司|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=7]]、[[冀|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]四州罷了。

passages.en: The Great Wei now holds the lands of ten provinces, yet has inherited the ravages of war and disorder. Its population, by calculation, is smaller than that of a single province in former times. But usurpers remain in two quarters, the northern tribes have not submitted, and three frontiers are beset by troubles; danger presses upon the realm from almost every side. Thus, in reality, we have the people of but one province, yet must administer the lands of nine. The difficulty is like driving a weary horse over a long road. How could we not carefully husband its remaining strength? Even with Cao Cao's (posthumously honoured as Emperor Wu, the Martial Emperor) frugality and full treasuries, the state could not sustain troops across ten provinces when it possessed only twenty commanderies. Now the frontier provinces of [[Jing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=2]], [[Yang Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=9]], [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]], [[Xu Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=8]], [[You Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=15]], [[Bing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=0]], [[Yong Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=14]], and [[Liang Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=5]] all maintain armies. Only [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]], [[Yu Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=16]], [[Si Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=7]], and [[Ji Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=4]] remain to supply the treasuries within and hold the peoples beyond the frontiers in check.

orig.zht: 臣前以州郡典兵，則專心軍功，不勤民事，宜別置將守，以盡治理之務；而陛下復以[[兾州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]寵秩呂昭。[[兾州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]戶口最多，田多墾闢，又有桑棗之饒，國家徵求之府，誠不當復任以兵事也。若以北方當須鎮守，自可專置大將以鎮安之。計所置吏士之費，與兼官無異。然昭於人才尚復易；中朝苟乏人，兼才者勢不獨多。以此推之，知國家以人擇官，不為官擇人也。官得其人，則政平訟理；政平故民富實，訟理故囹圄空虛。
orig.zhs: 臣前以州郡典兵，则专心军功，不勤民事，宜别置将守，以尽治理之务；而陛下复以[[兾州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]宠秩吕昭。[[兾州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]户口最多，田多垦辟，又有桑枣之饶，国家征求之府，诚不当复任以兵事也。若以北方当须镇守，自可专置大将以镇安之。计所置吏士之费，与兼官无异。然昭于人才尚复易；中朝苟乏人，兼才者势不独多。以此推之，知国家以人择官，不为官择人也。官得其人，则政平讼理；政平故民富实，讼理故囹圄空虚。

vern.zht: 我先前認爲：州、郡的長官如果掌管軍隊，就會專心建立軍功，不盡力於民政；應當另設將領和守令，以便盡到治理的職責。陛下卻又用[[冀州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]來尊寵並任命呂昭。[[冀州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]戶口最多，田地大多已經開墾，又有桑樹、棗樹的富饒，是國家徵收財物的府庫，實在不該再讓它承擔軍事事務。如果認爲北方必須鎮守，自然可以專門設置大將去鎮守安撫它。計算爲此設置的官吏和士兵的費用，與兼任官職沒有差別。然而，以人才而論，呂昭仍算是容易找到的；朝廷如果缺少人才，兼有文武才能的人勢必不會特別多。由此推斷，可知國家是在因人設置官職，而不是爲官職挑選人。官職得到合適的人選，政事就會平和，訴訟也會得到審理；政事平和，所以百姓富足充實；訴訟得到審理，所以監獄空虛。
vern.zhs: 我先前认为：州、郡的长官如果掌管军队，就会专心建立军功，不尽力于民政；应当另设将领和守令，以便尽到治理的职责。陛下却又用[[冀州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]来尊宠并任命吕昭。[[冀州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]户口最多，田地大多已经开垦，又有桑树、枣树的富饶，是国家征收财物的府库，实在不该再让它承担军事事务。如果认为北方必须镇守，自然可以专门设置大将去镇守安抚它。计算为此设置的官吏和士兵的费用，与兼任官职没有差别。然而，以人才而论，吕昭仍算是容易找到的；朝廷如果缺少人才，兼有文武才能的人势必不会特别多。由此推断，可知国家是在因人设置官职，而不是为官职挑选人。官职得到合适的人选，政事就会平和，诉讼也会得到审理；政事平和，所以百姓富足充实；诉讼得到审理，所以监狱空虚。

passages.en: I, your servant, previously believed that when provincial and commandery officials command troops, they devote themselves to military achievements and neglect civil affairs. Generals and governors should therefore be appointed separately, so that civil affairs may be properly administered. Yet Your Majesty has again honoured Lü Zhao with appointment over [[Ji Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]. [[Ji Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=4]] has the largest population, much cultivated land, and an abundance of mulberries and jujubes. It is the chief source of the state's levies and should certainly not also be burdened with military affairs. It is the chief source of the state's levies and should certainly not also be burdened with military affairs. If the north requires defence, a senior general may be appointed specifically to secure it. The cost of the necessary officers and troops would be no greater than if the civil and military offices remained combined. Even considering Lu Zhao alone, a man of his abilities could readily be replaced. Can the court truly be so lacking in men that those capable in both civil and military affairs are so few? From this, it appears that the state tailors offices to men, rather than selecting men to suit the offices. When the right man holds office, government is equitable and lawsuits are justly settled. Equitable government enriches the people; justly settled lawsuits leave the prisons empty.

orig.zht: 陛下踐阼，天下斷獄百數十人，歲歲增多，至五百餘人矣。民不益多，法不益峻。以此推之，非政教陵遲，牧守不稱之明效歟？往年牛死，通率天下十能損二；麥不半收，秋種未下。若二賊游魂於疆埸，飛芻輓粟，千[[里|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-li]]不及。究此之術，豈在彊兵乎？武士勁卒愈多，愈多愈病耳。夫天下猶人之體，腹心充實，四支雖病，終無大患；今[[兖|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]、[[豫|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=16]]、[[司|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=7]]、[[兾|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]亦天下之腹心也。是以愚臣慺慺，實願四州之牧守，獨脩務本之業，以堪四支之重。
orig.zhs: 陛下践阼，天下断狱百数十人，岁岁增多，至五百余人矣。民不益多，法不益峻。以此推之，非政教陵迟，牧守不称之明效欤？往年牛死，通率天下十能损二；麦不半收，秋种未下。若二贼游魂于疆埸，飞刍挽粟，千[[里|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-li]]不及。究此之术，岂在彊兵乎？武士劲卒愈多，愈多愈病耳。夫天下犹人之体，腹心充实，四支虽病，终无大患；今[[兖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]、[[豫|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=16]]、[[司|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=7]]、[[兾|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]亦天下之腹心也。是以愚臣㥪㥪，实愿四州之牧守，独修务本之业，以堪四支之重。

vern.zht: 陛下登基時，天下被判罪的人只有一百幾十人；年年增多，達到五百多人了。百姓沒有增多，刑法沒有更加嚴苛。由此推究，這難道不是政治教化衰敗、州郡長官不稱職的明證嗎？去年牛死亡，就全國平均而言，十頭牛裏損失兩頭；麥子收成不到一半，秋種還沒有下地。如果二賊仍在邊境上游蕩，即使飛運草料、挽運糧食，千[[里|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-li]]補給也來不及。推究應對此事的辦法，難道在於加強兵力嗎？勇士精兵越多，越多就越有害罷了。天下如同人的身體，心腹充實，四肢即使有病，終究沒有大的禍患；如今[[兗|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]州、[[豫|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=16]]州、[[司|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=7]]州、[[冀|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]州也是天下的心腹。因此愚臣懷着懇切之心，實在希望四州的牧守專心修治務農這個根本之業，來承受四肢的重負。
vern.zhs: 陛下登基时，天下被判罪的人只有一百几十人；年年增多，达到五百多人了。百姓没有增多，刑法没有更加严苛。由此推究，这难道不是政治教化衰败、州郡长官不称职的明证吗？去年牛死亡，就全国平均而言，十头牛里损失两头；麦子收成不到一半，秋种还没有下地。如果二贼仍在边境上游荡，即使飞运草料、挽运粮食，千[[里|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-li]]补给也来不及。推究应对此事的办法，难道在于加强兵力吗？勇士精兵越多，越多就越有害罢了。天下如同人的身体，心腹充实，四肢即使有病，终究没有大的祸患；如今[[兖|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=11]]州、[[豫|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=16]]州、[[司|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=7]]州、[[冀|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=4]]州也是天下的心腹。因此愚臣怀着恳切之心，实在希望四州的牧守专心修治务农这个根本之业，来承受四肢的重负。

passages.en: Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, the number condemned by courts throughout the realm has risen each year, from just over a hundred to more than five hundred. The population has not increased, nor have the laws grown harsher. Is this not clear proof that government and moral instruction are in decline, and that the Governors and Grand Administrators are not fit for their offices? In past years, two oxen in every ten died across the realm. This year, the wheat yielded less than half its former amount, and the autumn sowing has yet to begin. Should the two rebels continue to haunt the frontiers like wandering spirits, fodder and grain would have to be rushed forward, yet supplies transported a thousand [[Li|/translations/officials#glossary-li]] would never arrive in time. Can strengthening the army truly provide the remedy? The more warriors we raise, the more grievously the realm will suffer. The realm is like the human body. If the heart and belly are strong, sickness in the four limbs will cause no grave harm. Today, [[Yan Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=11]], [[Yu Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=16]], [[Si Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=7]], and [[Ji Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=4]] are the heart and belly of the realm. In my humble devotion, I therefore earnestly hope that the Governors and Grand Administrators of these four regions will devote themselves solely to strengthening the foundations, so that they may bear the burden of the four limbs.

orig.zht: 然孤論難持，犯欲難成，衆怨難積，疑似難分，故累載不為明主所察。凡言此者，類皆疏賤；疏賤之言，實未易聽。若使善策必出於親貴，親貴固不犯四難以求忠愛，此古今之所常患也。」
orig.zhs: 然孤论难持，犯欲难成，众怨难积，疑似难分，故累载不为明主所察。凡言此者，类皆疏贱；疏贱之言，实未易听。若使善策必出于亲贵，亲贵固不犯四难以求忠爱，此古今之所常患也。」

vern.zht: 然而孤立的議論難以堅持，觸犯別人的私慾難以成功，衆人的怨恨難以積聚，似是而非的情況難以分辨，所以多年來不被明主所察知。凡是說這些話的人，大多是被疏遠、地位卑賤的人；疏遠卑賤之人的話，實在不容易被聽從。假如好的策略一定要出自親近尊貴的人，親近尊貴的人本來就絕不會冒犯這四種難處去求取忠愛，這是古往今來都常有的憂患。
vern.zhs: 然而孤立的议论难以坚持，触犯别人的私欲难以成功，众人的怨恨难以积聚，似是而非的情况难以分辨，所以多年来不被明主所察知。凡是说这些话的人，大多是被疏远、地位卑贱的人；疏远卑贱之人的话，实在不容易被听从。假如好的策略一定要出自亲近尊贵的人，亲近尊贵的人本来就绝不会冒犯这四种难处去求取忠爱，这是古往今来都常有的忧患。

passages.en: Yet a lone opinion is hard to maintain, the ruler's wishes hard to oppose, the resentment of the many hard to bear, and truth hard to distinguish from falsehood. Thus such matters may escape even an enlightened ruler's notice for years. Those who speak of them are generally distant and lowly, and their words are never readily heard. If it is believed that sound counsel must come from intimates and dignitaries, such men will surely not brave these four difficulties merely for imperial favour. This has ever been a source of trouble in governing the realm, both in ancient times and today."

orig.zhs: 时又大议考课之制，以考内外众官。恕以为用不尽其人，虽才且无益，所存非所务，所务非世要。上疏曰：

vern.zht: 當時又大規模議論考課制度，用來考覈內外衆官。杜恕認爲用人不能讓人盡其才，即使有才也沒有益處；所關注的不是應致力的事情，所致力的事情也不是當世要務。於是上疏說：

passages.en: At the time, there was also renewed debate over establishing a system to assess the performance of officials both at court and in the provinces. Du Shu held that unless men's talents were put to their proper use, talent itself was of no avail. Their duties made little use of their talents, and what they accomplished could not answer the needs of the age. He submitted a memorial to the throne:

orig.zht: 「書稱『 明試以功，三考黜陟』，誠帝王之盛制。使有能者當其官，有功者受其祿，譬猶烏獲之舉千鈞，良、樂之選驥足也。雖歷六代而考績之法不著，關七聖而課試之文不垂，臣誠以為其法可粗依，其詳難備舉故也。語曰：『世有亂人而無亂法。』若使法可專任，則唐、虞可不須稷、契之佐，殷、周無貴伊、呂之輔矣。今奏考功者，陳周、漢之法為，終京房之本旨，可謂明考課之要矣。於以崇揖讓之風，興濟濟之治，臣以為未盡善也。
orig.zhs: 「书称『 明试以功，三考黜陟』，诚帝王之盛制。使有能者当其官，有功者受其禄，譬犹乌获之举千钧，良、乐之选骥足也。虽历六代而考绩之法不著，关七圣而课试之文不垂，臣诚以为其法可粗依，其详难备举故也。语曰：『世有乱人而无乱法。』若使法可专任，则唐、虞可不须稷、契之佐，殷、周无贵伊、吕之辅矣。今奏考功者，陈周、汉之法为，终京房之本旨，可谓明考课之要矣。于以崇揖让之风，兴济济之治，臣以为未尽善也。

vern.zht: 《尚書》中說：“明確地以功績試用，經過三次考察決定降免或升遷。”這確實是帝王盛大的制度。讓有才能的人擔任相稱的官職，讓有功績的人接受相應的俸祿，就好比烏獲舉起千鈞重物，王良、伯樂選取駿馬一樣。雖然經歷了六代，考績的制度仍不顯著；經過了七位聖人，課試的條文仍沒有流傳下來，我確實認爲，這是因爲考課的辦法只能粗略地依循，而詳細的條目難以完備列舉的緣故。俗話說：“世上有作亂的人，卻沒有作亂的法。”假如法令可以單獨依靠，那麼唐、虞就不需要稷、契的輔佐，殷、周也不會看重伊尹、呂望的輔助了。如今上奏考功的人，陳述周、漢兩代的法度，歸結於京房的根本宗旨，可以說是明白了考課的要領。用它來推崇禮讓的風氣，興起人才濟濟的治道，臣認爲還沒有達到盡善。
vern.zhs: 《尚书》中说：“明确地以功绩试用，经过三次考察决定降免或升迁。”这确实是帝王盛大的制度。让有才能的人担任相称的官职，让有功绩的人接受相应的俸禄，就好比乌获举起千钧重物，王良、伯乐选取骏马一样。虽然经历了六代，考绩的制度仍不显著；经过了七位圣人，课试的条文仍没有流传下来，我确实认为，这是因为考课的办法只能粗略地依循，而详细的条目难以完备列举的缘故。俗话说：“世上有作乱的人，却没有作乱的法。”假如法令可以单独依靠，那么唐、虞就不需要稷、契的辅佐，殷、周也不会看重伊尹、吕望的辅助了。如今上奏考功的人，陈述周、汉两代的法度，归结于京房的根本宗旨，可以说是明白了考课的要领。用它来推崇礼让的风气，兴起人才济济的治道，臣认为还没有达到尽善。

passages.en: "The Documents says, 'Examine them clearly by their achievements; after three examinations, demote or advance them.' This is indeed a splendid institution for emperors and kings. It ensures that the able hold the offices suited to them and the meritorious receive their due emoluments, just as Wu Huo could lift a thousand jun and Wang Liang and Bo Le could pick out the finest steeds. Though this system passed through six dynasties without its regulations recorded, and through seven sage rulers without their writings on it transmitted to us, I believe this is because its broad principles may be followed, but its particulars cannot all be set forth. There is a saying: 'It is men who cause disorder, not laws.' If laws alone could be relied upon, Yao and Shun would not have needed the aid of Ji and Xie, nor would the Shang and Zhou have prized the assistance of Yi Yin and Lü Shang. Those who now memorialise on the assessment of merit expound the methods of the Zhou and Han, and continued Jing Fang's fundamental principles. They may be said to have elucidated the essentials of official assessment. Yet as a means of fostering a spirit of courteous deference and filling the government with worthy men, I, your servant, do not consider their proposals wholly satisfactory.

orig.zht: 其欲使州郡考士，必由[[四科|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，皆有事效，然後察舉，試[[辟|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]公府，為親民長吏，[[轉|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]]以功次補郡守者，或就增秩賜爵，此最考課之急務也。臣以為便當顯其身，用其言，使具為課州郡之法，法具施行，立必信之賞，施必行之罰。至於公卿及內職大臣，亦當俱以其職考課之也。古之三公，坐而論道，內職大臣，納言補闕，無善不紀，無過不舉。且天下至大，萬機至衆，誠非一明所能徧照。故君為元首，臣作股肱，明其一體相須而成也。
orig.zhs: 其欲使州郡考士，必由[[四科|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，皆有事效，然后察举，试[[辟|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]]公府，为亲民长吏，[[转|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]]以功次补郡守者，或就增秩赐爵，此最考课之急务也。臣以为便当显其身，用其言，使具为课州郡之法，法具施行，立必信之赏，施必行之罚。至于公卿及内职大臣，亦当俱以其职考课之也。古之三公，坐而论道，内职大臣，纳言补阙，无善不纪，无过不举。且天下至大，万机至众，诚非一明所能徧照。故君为元首，臣作股肱，明其一体相须而成也。

vern.zht: 他們主張讓州郡考察士人，必須通過[[四科|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，都要有實際成效，然後才加以考察舉薦；由公府試用徵召，擔任親近百姓的長吏，再按功績和資歷遷轉補任郡守，有的便增加俸祿、賜給爵位，這是考覈官員最急迫的事務。臣認爲就應當表彰這些人，採納他們的意見，讓他們制定完備的考覈州郡的辦法；辦法制定完備後即施行，設立必定信守的賞賜，施行必定執行的懲罰。至於公卿和內職大臣，也應當都根據各自的官職來考覈。古代的三公，坐而論道；內職大臣，進獻諫言、彌補缺失；沒有善行不被記錄，沒有過失不被舉發。況且天下極大，政務極多，實在不是一個人的明察所能遍照。所以君主是元首，臣屬是股肱，表明他們是一體、相互依賴而成就事業的。
vern.zhs: 他们主张让州郡考察士人，必须通过[[四科|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]]，都要有实际成效，然后才加以考察举荐；由公府试用征召，担任亲近百姓的长吏，再按功绩和资历迁转补任郡守，有的便增加俸禄、赐给爵位，这是考核官员最急迫的事务。臣认为就应当表彰这些人，采纳他们的意见，让他们制定完备的考核州郡的办法；办法制定完备后即施行，设立必定信守的赏赐，施行必定执行的惩罚。至于公卿和内职大臣，也应当都根据各自的官职来考核。古代的三公，坐而论道；内职大臣，进献谏言、弥补缺失；没有善行不被记录，没有过失不被举发。况且天下极大，政务极多，实在不是一个人的明察所能遍照。所以君主是元首，臣属是股肱，表明他们是一体、相互依赖而成就事业的。

passages.en: If the provinces and commanderies are to assess men, the [[Four Categories|/translations/officials#glossary-flourishing-talent]] must be adopted, and only those with proven achievements in them should be recommended. Those recommended should then be [[recruited|/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]] on trial to the offices of the Excellencies and appointed as magistrates governing the people. Thereafter, they may be [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] by merit to vacancies as commandery administrators, or receive increases in rank and grants of nobility. This is the most urgent task in the assessment of officials. II, your servant, believe that those whose proposals have merit should be brought to prominence and their views adopted. On this basis, comprehensive regulations should be drawn up for assessing the provinces and commanderies and then put into effect, with rewards made certain and punishments inexorable. The Excellencies, ministers, and officials of the inner court should likewise be assessed according to the duties of their offices. In ancient times, the Three Excellencies sat and discoursed upon the Way, while ministers of the inner court conveyed counsel and filled in what was lacking. No merit went unrecorded and no fault unreported. The realm is vast and its affairs innumerable; no single intelligence can illuminate them all. Thus the ruler is the head and his ministers the limbs: together they form a single body, and neither can accomplish its task without the other.

orig.zht: 是以古人稱廊廟之材，非一木之枝；帝王之業，非一士之略。由是言之，焉有大臣守職辨課可以致雍熙者哉！且布衣之交，猶有務信誓而蹈水火，感知己而披肝膽，徇聲名而立節義者；況於束帶立朝，致位卿相，所務者非特匹夫之信，所感者非徒知己之惠，所徇者豈聲名而已乎！諸蒙寵祿受重任者，不徒欲舉明主於唐、虞之上而已；身亦欲厠稷、契之列。是以古人不患於念治之心不盡，患於自任之意不足，此誠人主使之然也。
orig.zhs: 是以古人称廊庙之材，非一木之枝；帝王之业，非一士之略。由是言之，焉有大臣守职辨课可以致雍熙者哉！且布衣之交，犹有务信誓而蹈水火，感知己而披肝胆，徇声名而立节义者；况于束带立朝，致位卿相，所务者非特匹夫之信，所感者非徒知己之惠，所徇者岂声名而已乎！诸蒙宠禄受重任者，不徒欲举明主于唐、虞之上而已；身亦欲厕稷、契之列。是以古人不患于念治之心不尽，患于自任之意不足，此诚人主使之然也。

vern.zht: 所以古人說：朝廷殿堂的木材，靠的不是一棵樹上的枝條；帝王的功業，靠的也不是一個人的謀略。由此說來，哪有大臣只靠謹守本職、考辨課績，就能帶來雍熙太平的呢！況且平民百姓之間的交往，尚且有人爲信守誓約而赴湯蹈火，爲感激知己而披肝瀝膽，爲追求聲名而樹立節義；何況那些束帶立於朝堂、官至卿相的人，他們所務求的不只是匹夫的信義，所感念的不只是知己的恩惠，所追求的難道只是聲名而已嗎！那些蒙受恩寵和俸祿而擔當重任的人，不只是想把明主推舉到唐、虞之上；他們自身也想置身於稷、契的行列。所以古人不擔心自己求治的心意不夠竭盡，而擔心自己擔當重任的意願不夠；這確實是君主使他們這樣的。
vern.zhs: 所以古人说：朝廷殿堂的木材，靠的不是一棵树上的枝条；帝王的功业，靠的也不是一个人的谋略。由此说来，哪有大臣只靠谨守本职、考辨课绩，就能带来雍熙太平的呢！况且平民百姓之间的交往，尚且有人为信守誓约而赴汤蹈火，为感激知己而披肝沥胆，为追求声名而树立节义；何况那些束带立于朝堂、官至卿相的人，他们所务求的不只是匹夫的信义，所感念的不只是知己的恩惠，所追求的难道只是声名而已吗！那些蒙受恩宠和俸禄而担当重任的人，不只是想把明主推举到唐、虞之上；他们自身也想置身于稷、契的行列。所以古人不担心自己求治的心意不够竭尽，而担心自己担当重任的意愿不够；这确实是君主使他们这样的。

passages.en: Therefore the ancients said that the timber for palaces and temples cannot come from a single tree, nor can an emperor's enterprise rest on the strategy of a single man. How, then, could great ministers bring about harmonious prosperity merely by keeping to their posts and assessment duties? Even friendships among commoners produce men who honour their pledges and brave fire and water, who bare their hearts in gratitude to those who understand them, and who uphold integrity at the cost of their lives for the sake of their good name. How much more so for those who don court robes, take their place among the ranks of officials, and rise to the highest ministerial offices? What these ministers pursue rises above the fidelity of an ordinary man; what moves them goes beyond the favour of one who understands them. Can it be that all they seek is merely reputation? Those entrusted with favour, emolument, and grave responsibilities seek not only to raise an enlightened ruler above Tang and Yu; they also aspire to rank alongside Ji and Xie. Thus the ancients did not fear that they lacked the desire to govern the realm well, but that they lacked the resolve to take its responsibilities upon themselves. That ministers should possess such resolve is, in truth, the work of their ruler.

orig.zht: 唐、虞之君，委任稷、契、夔、龍而責成功，及其罪也，殛鯀而放四凶。今大臣親奉明詔，給事目下，其有夙夜在公，恪勤特立，當官不撓貴勢，執平不阿所私，危言危行以處朝廷者，自明主所察也。若尸祿以為高，拱嘿以為智，當官苟在於免負，立朝不忘於容身，絜行遜言以處朝廷者，亦明主所察也。誠使容身保位，無放退之辜，而盡節在公，抱見疑之勢，公義不脩而私議成俗，雖仲尼為謀，猶不能盡一才，又況於世俗之人乎！
orig.zhs: 唐、虞之君，委任稷、契、夔、龙而责成功，及其罪也，殛鲧而放四凶。今大臣亲奉明诏，给事目下，其有夙夜在公，恪勤特立，当官不挠贵势，执平不阿所私，危言危行以处朝廷者，自明主所察也。若尸禄以为高，拱嘿以为智，当官苟在于免负，立朝不忘于容身，絜行逊言以处朝廷者，亦明主所察也。诚使容身保位，无放退之辜，而尽节在公，抱见疑之势，公义不修而私议成俗，虽仲尼为谋，犹不能尽一才，又况于世俗之人乎！

vern.zht: 唐、虞的君主，任用稷、契、夔、龍而要求他們成就事功；等到臣子有罪時，就處死鯀、放逐四凶。如今大臣們親自領受聖明的詔令，在君主眼前供職。其中那些日夜爲公事操勞，恭敬勤懇、特立出衆，任職時不屈服於權貴勢力，執法公正而不偏私，以正言正行立於朝廷的人，自然會被明主明察。至於那些把空受俸祿不理事當作清高，把拱手沉默不議政當作智慧，在官位上只求免除罪責，在朝堂上念念不忘保全自身，行爲收斂、言語謙退而置身朝廷的人，也同樣是明主所能明察的。如果真的讓那些只顧保全自身、保住職位的人沒有放逐罷退的罪責，而讓那些爲公家竭盡節操的人抱着被猜疑的處境，公正的道義得不到樹立，而徇私的議論成爲風氣，那麼即使是仲尼來出謀劃策，尚且不能讓一個人才充分施展他的才能，又何況世間平常的人呢！
vern.zhs: 唐、虞的君主，任用稷、契、夔、龙而要求他们成就事功；等到臣子有罪时，就处死鲧、放逐四凶。如今大臣们亲自领受圣明的诏令，在君主眼前供职。其中那些日夜为公事操劳，恭敬勤恳、特立出众，任职时不屈服于权贵势力，执法公正而不偏私，以正言正行立于朝廷的人，自然会被明主明察。至于那些把空受俸禄不理事当作清高，把拱手沉默不议政当作智慧，在官位上只求免除罪责，在朝堂上念念不忘保全自身，行为收敛、言语谦退而置身朝廷的人，也同样是明主所能明察的。如果真的让那些只顾保全自身、保住职位的人没有放逐罢退的罪责，而让那些为公家竭尽节操的人抱着被猜疑的处境，公正的道义得不到树立，而徇私的议论成为风气，那么即使是仲尼来出谋划策，尚且不能让一个人才充分施展他的才能，又何况世间平常的人呢！

passages.en: The sovereigns of Tang and Yu entrusted office to Ji, Xie, Kui, and Long, and held them responsible for success. When offences arose, they put Gun to death and banished the Four Evildoers. Today, the great ministers receive the enlightened sovereign's commands in person and serve beneath his very gaze. Those who labour for the public good from dawn till dusk, who are scrupulous and independent, who do not yield in office to the power of the great, who uphold impartiality without favouring their intimates, and who remain upright in word and deed at court, are known to an enlightened ruler. Those who pride themselves on drawing their salaries without rendering service, who regard folded hands and silence as wisdom, who seek only to avoid blame in office and preserve their standing at court, conducting themselves cautiously and speaking deferentially, are likewise known to an enlightened ruler. If ministers must think only of protecting themselves and preserving their positions to avoid fault that might lead to dismissal, while those who devote themselves wholeheartedly to public affairs instead fall under suspicion, then public righteousness will go unfulfilled while selfish private opinions become the prevailing custom. Even if Confucius devised the system, he could not make full use of every man's abilities; how much less could ordinary men do so?

vern.zhs: 现在的学者，效法商鞅、韩非而崇尚法度和权术，争相认为儒家学说迂阔而不切合当世之用，这是风俗中最严重的流弊，也是创业者最应当谨慎的。后来，考课制度终究没有施行。

passages.en: Scholars today take Shang Yang and Han Fei as their masters and exalt Legalist methods. They compete with one another in dismissing the Confucians as pedantic and impractical, unfit for the needs of the age. This is the gravest corruption of the prevailing custom, and those who found great enterprises must guard against it with particular care." In the end, the new system for evaluating officials was not implemented.

orig.zht: 「伏見[[尚書郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]廉昭奏[[左丞|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-034]]曹璠以罰當關不依詔，坐判問。又云「諸當坐者別奏」。[[尚書令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-031]]陳矯自奏不敢辭罰，亦不敢以處重為恭，意至懇惻。臣竊愍然為朝廷惜之！夫聖人不擇世而興，不易民而治，然而生必有賢智之佐者，蓋進之以道，率之以禮故也。古之帝王之所以能輔世長民者，莫不遠得百姓之懽心，近盡羣臣之智力。誠使今朝任職之臣皆天下之選，而不能盡其力，不可謂能使人；若非天下之選，亦不可謂能官人。
orig.zhs: 「伏见[[尚书郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]廉昭奏[[左丞|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-034]]曹璠以罚当关不依诏，坐判问。又云「诸当坐者别奏」。[[尚书令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-031]]陈矫自奏不敢辞罚，亦不敢以处重为恭，意至恳恻。臣窃愍然为朝廷惜之！夫圣人不择世而兴，不易民而治，然而生必有贤智之佐者，盖进之以道，率之以礼故也。古之帝王之所以能辅世长民者，莫不远得百姓之懽心，近尽群臣之智力。诚使今朝任职之臣皆天下之选，而不能尽其力，不可谓能使人；若非天下之选，亦不可谓能官人。

vern.zht: 我看到[[尚書郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]廉昭奏稱：[[左丞|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-034]]曹璠因處罰應當報告卻沒有依詔令辦理，被治罪審問；又奏說“其他應當治罪的人另行上奏”。[[尚書令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-031]]陳矯親自上奏說，自己不敢推避處罰，但也不敢以加重處罰來表示恭敬，情意十分懇切悲惻。我私下裏感到憂傷，替朝廷惋惜這件事。聖人不會選擇時代才興起，也不會更換民衆才治理；然而他們興起時必定有賢能智慧的輔佐者，這大概是因爲用道義進用他們、用禮法統率他們的緣故。古代的帝王之所以能輔佐世道、統領百姓，沒有不是遠能得到百姓的歡心、近能使羣臣充分發揮才智和力量的。如果如今在朝廷任職的臣子都是天下推選出來的人才，卻不能讓他們充分發揮力量，就不能說是會用人；如果他們不是天下推選出來的人才，也不能說是會委任官員。
vern.zhs: 我看到[[尚书郎|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]]廉昭奏称：[[左丞|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-034]]曹璠因处罚应当报告却没有依诏令办理，被治罪审问；又奏说“其他应当治罪的人另行上奏”。[[尚书令|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-031]]陈矫亲自上奏说，自己不敢推避处罚，但也不敢以加重处罚来表示恭敬，情意十分恳切悲恻。我私下里感到忧伤，替朝廷惋惜这件事。圣人不会选择时代才兴起，也不会更换民众才治理；然而他们兴起时必定有贤能智慧的辅佐者，这大概是因为用道义进用他们、用礼法统率他们的缘故。古代的帝王之所以能辅佐世道、统领百姓，没有不是远能得到百姓的欢心、近能使群臣充分发挥才智和力量的。如果如今在朝廷任职的臣子都是天下推选出来的人才，却不能让他们充分发挥力量，就不能说是会用人；如果他们不是天下推选出来的人才，也不能说是会委任官员。

passages.en: "I have seen the memorial of [[Imperial Secretariat Gentleman|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-037]] Lian Zhao, accusing Cao Fan, the [[Imperial Secretariat Left Assistant|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-034]], of imposing punishments contrary to the orders outlined in the imperial edicts. Cao Fan was tried and questioned. He further stated: 'All others who should be held culpable are to be reported separately.' Chen Jiao, [[Director of the Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-031]], has submitted a memorial declaring that he dares not evade punishment, nor impose heavy penalties. His words are most earnest and heartfelt. I am deeply grieved and regret this for the sake of the court. Sages do not choose their age before arising, nor choose another people to govern. Yet worthy and wise men invariably come forward to assist them, because they are advanced in accordance with the Way and guided by ritual. The emperors and kings of old could uphold their age and govern the people, because they won the willing allegiance of the common people throughout the realm and drew fully upon the wisdom and strength of their ministers at court. If those now holding office are indeed the finest men in the realm, yet cannot exercise their abilities to the full, then it cannot be said that men are being properly employed. If they are not the finest men in the realm, then it cannot be said that appointments are being properly made.

orig.zht: 陛下憂勞萬機，或親燈火，而庶事不康，刑禁日弛，豈非股肱不稱之明效歟？原其所由，非獨臣有不盡忠，亦主有不能使。百里奚愚於虞而智於秦，豫讓苟容中行而著節智伯，斯則古人之明驗矣。今臣言一朝皆不忠，是誣一朝也；然其事類，可推而得。陛下感帑藏之不充實，而軍事未息，至乃斷四時之賦衣，薄御府之私穀，帥由聖意，舉朝稱明，與聞政事密勿大臣，寧有懇懇憂此者乎？
orig.zhs: 陛下忧劳万机，或亲灯火，而庶事不康，刑禁日弛，岂非股肱不称之明效欤？原其所由，非独臣有不尽忠，亦主有不能使。百里奚愚于虞而智于秦，豫让苟容中行而著节智伯，斯则古人之明验矣。今臣言一朝皆不忠，是诬一朝也；然其事类，可推而得。陛下感帑藏之不充实，而军事未息，至乃断四时之赋衣，薄御府之私谷，帅由圣意，举朝称明，与闻政事密勿大臣，宁有恳恳忧此者乎？

vern.zht: 陛下日理萬機，憂心勞苦，有時甚至夜以繼日；然而各項事務並不順利，刑法禁令日漸鬆弛，這難道不是股肱大臣不稱職的明顯效驗嗎？推究其中的緣由，不只是臣下有不盡忠之處，也是君主有不能任用人才的地方。百里奚在虞國顯得愚鈍，在秦國卻顯得有智慧；豫讓在中行氏那裏只求苟且容身，在智伯那裏卻顯揚節操，這就是古人顯著的驗證了。現在我說滿朝官員都不忠，這是在誣衊滿朝官員；但同類的情況，可以推究得出。陛下爲國庫不充實而憂慮，而戰事還沒有停息，甚至停止四時分賜的衣服，減少御府中私用的糧食，這些都出自聖意，滿朝都稱讚陛下英明；那些參與機要政事的大臣，難道有誰懇切地憂慮這些事嗎？
vern.zhs: 陛下日理万机，忧心劳苦，有时甚至夜以继日；然而各项事务并不顺利，刑法禁令日渐松弛，这难道不是股肱大臣不称职的明显效验吗？推究其中的缘由，不只是臣下有不尽忠之处，也是君主有不能任用人才的地方。百里奚在虞国显得愚钝，在秦国却显得有智慧；豫让在中行氏那里只求苟且容身，在智伯那里却显扬节操，这就是古人显著的验证了。现在我说满朝官员都不忠，这是在诬蔑满朝官员；但同类的情况，可以推究得出。陛下为国库不充实而忧虑，而战事还没有停息，甚至停止四时分赐的衣服，减少御府中私用的粮食，这些都出自圣意，满朝都称赞陛下英明；那些参与机要政事的大臣，难道有谁恳切地忧虑这些事吗？

passages.en: Your Majesty wears yourself out over the myriad affairs of state, sometimes personally labouring by lamplight, Yet public affairs remain unsettled, and the enforcement of the laws grows more lax by the day. Is this not clear proof that your ministers are unequal to their responsibilities? If we seek the cause, it lies not only in ministers failing to give their full loyalty, but also in a ruler's inability to employ them. Baili Xi seemed a fool in Yu but proved wise in Qin; Yu Rang merely held his place under Zhonghang, but won renown for his fidelity to Zhi Bo. These are clear precedents from antiquity. Were I to say that the entire court is disloyal, I would be slandering the entire court. Yet the truth may be inferred from the nature of events. Distressed that the treasury remains depleted while warfare continues unabated, Your Majesty has gone so far as to discontinue the seasonal provision of robes and reduce the grain reserved for imperial use. These measures were Your Majesty's own initiative, and the whole court acclaimed your wisdom. Yet among the senior ministers privy to affairs of state, has any shown heartfelt concern over matters like this?

orig.zht: [[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]王才、幸樂人孟思所為不法，振動京都，而其罪狀發於小吏，公卿大臣初無一言。自陛下踐阼以來，[[司隷校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]、[[御史中丞|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]]寧有舉綱維以督姦宄，使朝廷肅然者邪？若陛下以為今世無良才，朝廷乏賢佐，豈可追望稷、契之遐蹤，坐待來世之儁乂乎！今之所謂賢者，盡有大官而享厚祿矣，然而奉上之節未立，向公之心不一者，委任之責不專，而俗多忌諱故也。臣以為忠臣不必親，親臣不必忠。何者？以其居無嫌之地而事得自盡也。
orig.zhs: [[骑都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]王才、幸乐人孟思所为不法，振动京都，而其罪状发于小吏，公卿大臣初无一言。自陛下践阼以来，[[司隷校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]、[[御史中丞|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]]宁有举纲维以督奸宄，使朝廷肃然者邪？若陛下以为今世无良才，朝廷乏贤佐，岂可追望稷、契之遐踪，坐待来世之俊乂乎！今之所谓贤者，尽有大官而享厚禄矣，然而奉上之节未立，向公之心不一者，委任之责不专，而俗多忌讳故也。臣以为忠臣不必亲，亲臣不必忠。何者？以其居无嫌之地而事得自尽也。

vern.zht: [[騎都尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]王才和受寵幸的樂人孟思的所作所爲不合法度，震動了京都，而他們的罪狀是由小吏揭發出來的，公卿大臣起初一句話也沒有說。自從陛下即位以來，[[司隸校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]、[[御史中丞|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]]難道有誰伸張綱紀法度來督察奸邪，使朝廷整肅的嗎？如果陛下認爲當今之世沒有良才，朝廷缺乏賢能的輔佐，難道可以追慕稷、契遙遠的蹤跡，坐等後世才德出衆的人嗎！如今所謂賢能的人，都已經做了大官、享受厚祿了；然而他們侍奉君上的節操沒有樹立，爲公家辦事的心意不專一，原因就在於委派給他們的職責不專一，而世俗中多有忌諱的緣故。臣認爲忠臣不一定要與君主親近，與君主親近的臣子不一定忠誠。爲什麼呢？因爲他們處在沒有嫌疑的地位，做起事來能夠竭盡自己的心力。
vern.zhs: [[骑都尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]]王才和受宠幸的乐人孟思的所作所为不合法度，震动了京都，而他们的罪状是由小吏揭发出来的，公卿大臣起初一句话也没有说。自从陛下即位以来，[[司隶校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]、[[御史中丞|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]]难道有谁伸张纲纪法度来督察奸邪，使朝廷整肃的吗？如果陛下认为当今之世没有良才，朝廷缺乏贤能的辅佐，难道可以追慕稷、契遥远的踪迹，坐等后世才德出众的人吗！如今所谓贤能的人，都已经做了大官、享受厚禄了；然而他们侍奉君上的节操没有树立，为公家办事的心意不专一，原因就在于委派给他们的职责不专一，而世俗中多有忌讳的缘故。臣认为忠臣不一定要与君主亲近，与君主亲近的臣子不一定忠诚。为什么呢？因为他们处在没有嫌疑的地位，做起事来能够竭尽自己的心力。

passages.en: The unlawful acts of Wang Cai, [[Commandant of Cavalry|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-i-178]], and Meng Si, a favoured entertainer, shook the capital, yet their crimes were exposed by a petty official, while the highest ministers initially said not a word. Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, has any [[Colonel of the Capital|/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]] or [[Deputy Imperial Censor|/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]] upheld law and discipline, curbed wickedness, and inspired awe throughout the court? If Your Majesty believes that this age has no men of worth and the court lacks able counsellors, are we then merely admiring the distant example of Ji and Xie, while sitting idle and awaiting the outstanding men of a future age? Those now deemed worthy all hold high office and enjoy generous stipends. Yet they have shown neither steadfast devotion to their sovereign nor single-minded dedication to the public good. This is because responsibility is not entrusted exclusively, while prevailing custom imposes too many restraints. I, your servant, believe that a loyal minister need not be close to the sovereign, nor is a close minister necessarily loyal. Why is this? Because when a man occupies a position that gives no cause for suspicion, he can devote himself wholly to his duties.

orig.zht: 今有疏者毀人不實其所毀，而必曰私報所憎，譽人不實其所譽，而必曰私愛所親，左右或因之以進憎愛之說。非獨毀譽有之，政事損益，亦皆有嫌。陛下當思所以闡廣朝臣之心，篤厲有道之節，使之自同古人，望與竹帛耳。反使如廉昭者擾亂其間，臣懼大臣遂將容身保位，坐觀得失，為來世戒也！
orig.zhs: 今有疏者毁人不实其所毁，而必曰私报所憎，誉人不实其所誉，而必曰私爱所亲，左右或因之以进憎爱之说。非独毁誉有之，政事损益，亦皆有嫌。陛下当思所以阐广朝臣之心，笃厉有道之节，使之自同古人，望与竹帛耳。反使如廉昭者扰乱其间，臣惧大臣遂将容身保位，坐观得失，为来世戒也！

vern.zht: 如今，如果有與陛下關係疏遠的人批評別人，而批評的內容不符合事實，人們就一定會說他是私下報復自己憎恨的人；如果他稱讚別人，而稱讚的內容不符合事實，人們就一定會說他是偏愛自己親近的人。陛下身邊的人有的還會藉此進獻帶有個人愛憎的言論。不只是批評和稱讚有這種情況，政事上的增損變革，也都同樣會招來猜疑。陛下應當考慮如何開闊朝臣們的心胸，砥礪有德之士的節操，使他們自覺地向古人看齊，期望他們能留名竹帛。反而讓像廉昭這樣的人從中擾亂，我擔心大臣們將會只顧容身保位，坐觀朝政得失，成爲後世的鑑戒！
vern.zhs: 如今，如果有与陛下关系疏远的人批评别人，而批评的内容不符合事实，人们就一定会说他是私下报复自己憎恨的人；如果他称赞别人，而称赞的内容不符合事实，人们就一定会说他是偏爱自己亲近的人。陛下身边的人有的还会借此进献带有个人爱憎的言论。不只是批评和称赞有这种情况，政事上的增损变革，也都同样会招来猜疑。陛下应当考虑如何开阔朝臣们的心胸，砥砺有德之士的节操，使他们自觉地向古人看齐，期望他们能留名竹帛。反而让像廉昭这样的人从中扰乱，我担心大臣们将会只顾容身保位，坐观朝政得失，成为后世的鉴戒！

passages.en: Now, when a distant minister criticises someone, Your Majesty suspects that he is privately taking revenge on one he hates; when he praises someone, Your Majesty suspects that he is privately favouring one close to him. Those around Your Majesty may then take the opportunity to allege their own personal likes and dislikes, and so distant ministers dare no longer offer either criticism or praise. It is not only praise and censure that are affected; every proposal to alter government policy likewise arouses suspicion. I hope Your Majesty will consider how to give freer scope to the minds of your ministers at court and strengthen the integrity of men, so that they may model themselves on the ancients and aspire only to leave their names in the histories. Instead, men such as Lian Zhao are allowed to sow confusion among them. I fear that henceforth the great ministers will seek only to protect themselves and preserve their positions, sitting by as affairs prosper or fail, leaving a warning to generations to come!

orig.zht: 昔周公戒魯侯曰「無使大臣怨乎不以」，言賢愚明皆當世用也。堯數舜之功，稱去四凶，不言大小，有罪則去也。今者朝臣不自以為不能，以陛下為不任也；不自以為不知，以陛下為不問也。陛下何不遵周公之所以用，大舜之所以去？使[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]、[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]坐則侍帷幄，行則從華輦，親對詔問，所陳必達，則羣臣之行能否，皆可得而知；忠能者進，闇劣者退，誰敢依違而不自盡？
orig.zhs: 昔周公戒鲁侯曰「无使大臣怨乎不以」，言贤愚明皆当世用也。尧数舜之功，称去四凶，不言大小，有罪则去也。今者朝臣不自以为不能，以陛下为不任也；不自以为不知，以陛下为不问也。陛下何不遵周公之所以用，大舜之所以去？使[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]、[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]坐则侍帷幄，行则从华辇，亲对诏问，所陈必达，则群臣之行能否，皆可得而知；忠能者进，暗劣者退，谁敢依违而不自尽？

vern.zht: 從前周公告誡魯侯說：“不要讓大臣因爲不被任用而怨恨。”這是說，不論賢能還是愚陋的人，都應當爲當世所任用。堯列舉舜的功績，稱讚他除去四凶，而不說四凶罪過的大小，只要有罪就除去。如今朝臣不認爲自己沒有才能，卻認爲陛下不任用他們；不認爲自己沒有才智，卻認爲陛下不詢問他們。陛下爲什麼不遵循周公用人的原則、大舜除人的原則呢？讓[[侍中|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]、[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]在您安坐時就侍奉在帷幄旁，出行時就跟隨在華輦後，親自應答詔問，所陳述的意見必定上達；這樣，羣臣的操行和能力如何，就都可以得知了。忠誠而有才能的人進用，昏愚低劣的人斥退，誰還敢猶豫遲疑而不竭盡自己的心力呢？
vern.zhs: 从前周公告诫鲁侯说：“不要让大臣因为不被任用而怨恨。”这是说，不论贤能还是愚陋的人，都应当为当世所任用。尧列举舜的功绩，称赞他除去四凶，而不说四凶罪过的大小，只要有罪就除去。如今朝臣不认为自己没有才能，却认为陛下不任用他们；不认为自己没有才智，却认为陛下不询问他们。陛下为什么不遵循周公用人的原则、大舜除人的原则呢？让[[侍中|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]]、[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]在您安坐时就侍奉在帷幄旁，出行时就跟随在华辇后，亲自应答诏问，所陈述的意见必定上达；这样，群臣的操行和能力如何，就都可以得知了。忠诚而有才能的人进用，昏愚低劣的人斥退，谁还敢犹豫迟疑而不竭尽自己的心力呢？

passages.en: Long ago, the Duke of Zhou admonished the Marquis of Lu: 'Do not let great ministers resent being left unemployed.' He meant that the worthy and unworthy should be clearly distinguished and employed as the age required. When Yao recounted Shun's achievements, he praised him for casting out the Four Villains. He made no distinction of rank: whoever was guilty was removed. Court officials today do not believe themselves incapable, but believe that Your Majesty has failed to employ them; they do not believe themselves ignorant, but believe that Your Majesty has failed to consult them. Why does Your Majesty not follow the Duke of Zhou's principles in employing men and the Great Shun's principles in dismissing them? Let the [[Palace Attendants|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-001]] and officials of the [[Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]] attend within the curtains when Your Majesty is seated and accompany the splendid carriage when you travel. Let them personally answer your questions, so that every voice may reach you. Then the conduct and abilities of every minister may be known. Advance the loyal and capable, and dismiss the benighted and inferior. Who then would dare equivocate rather than exert himself to the utmost?

orig.zht: 以陛下之聖明，親與羣臣論議政事，使羣臣人得自盡，人自以為親，人思所以報，賢愚能否，在陛下之所用。以此治事，何事不辦？以此建功，何功不成？每有軍事，詔書常曰：「誰當憂此者邪？吾當自憂耳。」近詔又曰：「憂公忘私者必不然，但先公後私即自辦也。」伏讀明詔，乃知聖思究盡下情，然亦怪陛下不治其本而憂其末也。人之能否，實有本性，雖臣亦以為朝臣不盡稱職也。
orig.zhs: 以陛下之圣明，亲与群臣论议政事，使群臣人得自尽，人自以为亲，人思所以报，贤愚能否，在陛下之所用。以此治事，何事不办？以此建功，何功不成？每有军事，诏书常曰：「谁当忧此者邪？吾当自忧耳。」近诏又曰：「忧公忘私者必不然，但先公后私即自办也。」伏读明诏，乃知圣思究尽下情，然亦怪陛下不治其本而忧其末也。人之能否，实有本性，虽臣亦以为朝臣不尽称职也。

vern.zht: 憑陛下的聖明，親自與羣臣議論政事，使羣臣人人都能儘自己的心力，人人都覺得自己與陛下親近，人人都想着如何報答；人的賢愚、能幹與否，全在於陛下如何任用。用這樣的做法處理政事，有什麼事辦不成？用這樣的做法建立功業，有什麼功業建不成？每當有軍事時，詔書常常說：“誰該爲這事憂慮呢？我應當自己憂慮罷了。”近來的詔書又說：“公而忘私不一定做得到，但先公後私，事情自然就辦好了。”我恭敬地拜讀聖明的詔書，才知道陛下的聖明思慮完全體察了下情；然而我也對陛下不治理根本卻憂慮末節感到不解。人的能幹與否，確實有天賦本性；即便是臣也認爲朝臣並不都稱職。
vern.zhs: 凭陛下的圣明，亲自与群臣议论政事，使群臣人人都能尽自己的心力，人人都觉得自己与陛下亲近，人人都想着如何报答；人的贤愚、能干与否，全在于陛下如何任用。用这样的做法处理政事，有什么事办不成？用这样的做法建立功业，有什么功业建不成？每当有军事时，诏书常常说：“谁该为这事忧虑呢？我应当自己忧虑罢了。”近来的诏书又说：“公而忘私不一定做得到，但先公后私，事情自然就办好了。”我恭敬地拜读圣明的诏书，才知道陛下的圣明思虑完全体察了下情；然而我也对陛下不治理根本却忧虑末节感到不解。人的能干与否，确实有天赋本性；即便是臣也认为朝臣并不都称职。

passages.en: With Your Majesty's sagacity, you personally deliberate affairs of government with your ministers, allowing each to exert himself to the utmost. Each feels close to you and considers how he may repay you. Whether men prove worthy or mediocre, capable or incapable, depends entirely on how Your Majesty employs them. What affair could not be managed in this way? What achievement could not be attained? Whenever military matters arise, edicts invariably say, 'Who should bear this concern? I shall bear it myself.' A recent edict also said, 'Men cannot truly be expected to serve the public good and forget private interests. It is enough that they put public concerns before private ones, and affairs will naturally be accomplished.' On humbly reading this enlightened edict, I saw that Your Majesty's sagacious thought had fully fathomed the sentiments of those below. Yet I also venture to suggest that Your Majesty may be concerning yourself with the consequences rather than addressing the root. Whether a man is capable or not does indeed depend on his innate nature, and even I believe that not all the ministers at court are equal to their offices.

orig.zht: 明主之用人也，使能者不敢遺其力，而不能者不得處非其任。選舉非其人，未必為有罪也；舉朝共容非其人，乃為怪耳。陛下知其不盡力也，而代之憂其職，知其不能也，而教之治其事，豈徒主勞而臣逸哉？雖聖賢並世，終不能以此為治也。陛下又患臺閣禁令之不密，人事請屬之不絕，聽伊尹作迎客出入之制，選[[司徒|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]更惡吏以守寺門；威禁由之，實未得為禁之本也。
orig.zhs: 明主之用人也，使能者不敢遗其力，而不能者不得处非其任。选举非其人，未必为有罪也；举朝共容非其人，乃为怪耳。陛下知其不尽力也，而代之忧其职，知其不能也，而教之治其事，岂徒主劳而臣逸哉？虽圣贤并世，终不能以此为治也。陛下又患台阁禁令之不密，人事请属之不绝，听伊尹作迎客出入之制，选[[司徒|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]更恶吏以守寺门；威禁由之，实未得为禁之本也。

vern.zht: 聖明的君主任用人時，使有才能的人不敢不竭盡自己的力量，使沒有才能的人不得處在不適合他的職位上。選拔舉薦的人不合適，不一定是有罪；滿朝上下共同容忍那個不合適的人，纔是怪事。陛下知道他們不盡心盡力，卻替他們憂慮他們分內的事務；知道他們沒有才能，卻教他們處理事務，這難道只是君主勞苦而臣下安逸嗎？即使聖賢同處一世，終究不能靠這種做法來治理國家。陛下又擔心臺閣的禁令不嚴密，人事請託不斷絕，讓伊尹制定迎客出入的制度，又讓[[司徒|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]選更兇惡的吏員來把守臺閣；威嚴的禁令由此得以施行，其實並沒有抓住禁令的根本。
vern.zhs: 圣明的君主任用人时，使有才能的人不敢不竭尽自己的力量，使没有才能的人不得处在不适合他的职位上。选拔举荐的人不合适，不一定是有罪；满朝上下共同容忍那个不合适的人，才是怪事。陛下知道他们不尽心尽力，却替他们忧虑他们分内的事务；知道他们没有才能，却教他们处理事务，这难道只是君主劳苦而臣下安逸吗？即使圣贤同处一世，终究不能靠这种做法来治理国家。陛下又担心台阁的禁令不严密，人事请托不断绝，让伊尹制定迎客出入的制度，又让[[司徒|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]]选更凶恶的吏员来把守台阁；威严的禁令由此得以施行，其实并没有抓住禁令的根本。

passages.en: An enlightened ruler employs men so that the able dare not withhold their utmost efforts, while the incapable cannot remain in posts beyond their competence. To select the wrong man is not necessarily culpable; what is extraordinary is for the whole court to tolerate him. Your Majesty knows that such men do not exert themselves fully, yet worries about their offices on their behalf; knows that they are incapable, yet instructs them in the conduct of their duties. Can this result in anything but toil for the ruler and ease for his ministers? Even if sages and worthies all arose in the same age, order could not be brought to the realm in this way. Your Majesty is also troubled that prohibitions within the palace and departments are not strictly enforced, and that private solicitations and appeals never cease. Even if Yi Yin himself framed rules governing the reception and passage of visitors, and the [[Excellency over the Masses|/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-001]] appointed sterner clerks to guard the office gates, such measures might enforce obedience through fear, but they would not address the root of the abuse.

orig.zht: 昔漢安帝時，[[少府|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]竇嘉[[辟|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]][[廷尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-221]]郭躬無罪之兄子，猶見舉奏，章劾紛紛。近[[司隷校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]孔羨[[辟|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]][[大將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]狂悖之弟，而有司嘿爾，望風希指，甚於受屬。選舉不以實，人事之大者也。嘉有親戚之寵，躬非社稷重臣，猶尚如此；以今況古，陛下自不督必行之罰以絕阿黨之原耳。伊尹之制，與惡吏守門，非治世之具也。使臣之言少蒙察納，何患於姦不削滅，而養若昭等乎！
orig.zhs: 昔汉安帝时，[[少府|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]窦嘉[[辟|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]][[廷尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-221]]郭躬无罪之兄子，犹见举奏，章劾纷纷。近[[司隷校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]孔羡[[辟|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]][[大将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]狂悖之弟，而有司嘿尔，望风希指，甚于受属。选举不以实，人事之大者也。嘉有亲戚之宠，躬非社稷重臣，犹尚如此；以今况古，陛下自不督必行之罚以绝阿党之原耳。伊尹之制，与恶吏守门，非治世之具也。使臣之言少蒙察纳，何患于奸不削灭，而养若昭等乎！

vern.zht: 從前漢安帝時，[[少府|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]竇嘉徵召了[[廷尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-221]]郭躬那個無罪的侄子，尚且被人檢舉上奏，彈劾的奏章紛紛不斷。近來[[司隸校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]孔羨徵召了[[大將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]那個狂妄悖逆的弟弟，而有關官員卻默不作聲，看風使舵、迎合意旨，比接受請託還要嚴重。選拔舉薦不依據實情，是人事上重大的問題。竇嘉有外戚的寵幸，郭躬不是國家重臣，尚且如此；拿今天的情況比照古代，陛下自己沒有督促必須實行的刑罰來杜絕結黨營私的根源罷了。伊尹的制度，讓兇惡吏員守門，不是治理天下的辦法。假使我的話能稍加審察採納，又何必擔心奸邪不能消滅，哪裏還用養着像廉昭等人呢？
vern.zhs: 从前汉安帝时，[[少府|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]]窦嘉征召了[[廷尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-221]]郭躬那个无罪的侄子，尚且被人检举上奏，弹劾的奏章纷纷不断。近来[[司隶校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]孔羡征召了[[大将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]那个狂妄悖逆的弟弟，而有关官员却默不作声，看风使舵、迎合意旨，比接受请托还要严重。选拔举荐不依据实情，是人事上重大的问题。窦嘉有外戚的宠幸，郭躬不是国家重臣，尚且如此；拿今天的情况比照古代，陛下自己没有督促必须实行的刑罚来杜绝结党营私的根源罢了。伊尹的制度，让凶恶吏员守门，不是治理天下的办法。假使我的话能稍加审察采纳，又何必担心奸邪不能消灭，哪里还用养着像廉昭等人呢？

passages.en: During the reign of Emperor An of Han, Dou Jia, the [[Minister of the Lesser Treasury|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-256]], [[recruited|/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]] an innocent nephew of Guo Gong, the [[Commandant of Justice|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-221]]. Even so, he was impeached, and memorials denouncing him came in a flood. Recently, Kong Xian, [[Colonel of the Capital|/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]], [[recruited|/translations/officials#glossary-recruit]] the [[Grand General|/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]'s arrogant and unruly younger brother, yet the responsible officials remained silent, watching the prevailing winds and seeking to anticipate his wishes. This was worse than yielding to private solicitation. To make appointments without regard to merit is a matter of the gravest consequence. Dou Jia enjoyed favour as an imperial kinsman, while Guo Gong was no minister on whom the dynasty's survival depended, yet even then the response was such. Compared with the past, the present state of affairs exists only because Your Majesty does not personally ensure that punishment is inexorably enforced, thereby cutting off favouritism and faction at their source. The institutions of Yi Yin and the posting of wicked officials at the gates are no instruments for governing an orderly age. If my words should receive even the slightest consideration, why should treachery not be rooted out? Why continue to tolerate the likes of Lian Zhao?

annotations.zht: 臣松之案[[大將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]，司馬宣王也。晉書云：「宣王第五弟，名通，為[[司隷|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]從事。」疑恕所云狂悖者。通子順，封龍陽[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。晉初受禪，以不達天命，守節不移，削爵土，徙[[武威|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]。
annotations.zhs: 臣松之案[[大将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]，司马宣王也。晋书云：「宣王第五弟，名通，为[[司隷|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]从事。」疑恕所云狂悖者。通子顺，封龙阳[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。晋初受禅，以不达天命，守节不移，削爵土，徙[[武威|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]。

vern.zht: 臣松之案：[[大將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]，指的是司馬宣王司馬懿。《晉書》說：宣王的第五個弟弟名字叫通，擔任[[司隸|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]從事。懷疑杜恕所說的狂妄悖逆的人。司馬通的兒子司馬順，封爲龍陽[[亭侯|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。晉朝剛剛接受禪讓的時候，因爲他不明白天命，堅守節操而不變節，被削除爵位和封地，流放到[[武威|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]。
vern.zhs: 臣松之案：[[大将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]]，指的是司马宣王司马懿。《晋书》说：宣王的第五个弟弟名字叫通，担任[[司隶|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]从事。怀疑杜恕所说的狂妄悖逆的人。司马通的儿子司马顺，封为龙阳[[亭侯|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]]。晋朝刚刚接受禅让的时候，因为他不明白天命，坚守节操而不变节，被削除爵位和封地，流放到[[武威|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=138]]。

annotations.en: Your servant Songzhi notes that the [[Grand General|/translations/officials/ministers#superior-excellency-064]] was Sima Yi (posthumously honoured as King Xuan, the Renowned King). The Book of Jin states: "King Xuan's fifth younger brother, named Tong, served as an aide to the [[Colonel of the Capital|/translations/officials/regional#sili-001]]." I suspect he was the reckless and rebellious man mentioned by Du Shu. Sima Tong's son Sima Shun was enfeoffed as [[Neighbourhood Marquis|/translations/officials#glossary-capital-neighbourhood-neighbourhood-marquis]] of Longyang. When Jin first accepted the abdication from Wei, Sima Shun refused to recognise Heaven's mandate and remained steadfast in his allegiance. He was stripped of his title and fief and exiled to [[Wuwei|/maps/map-overall?admin=138]].

orig.zht: 夫糾擿姦宄，忠事也，然而世憎小人行之者，以其不顧道理而苟求容進也。若陛下不復考其終始，必以違衆忤世為奉公，密行白人為盡節，焉有通人大才而更不能為此邪？誠顧道理而弗為耳。使天下皆背道而趨利，則人主之所最病者，陛下將何樂焉，胡不絕其萌乎！夫先意承旨以求容美，率皆天下淺薄無行義者，其意務在於適人主之心而已，非欲治天下安百姓也。陛下何不試變業而示之，彼豈執其所守以違聖意哉？夫人臣得人主之心，安業也；處尊顯之官，榮事也；食千鍾之祿，厚實也。
orig.zhs: 夫纠擿奸宄，忠事也，然而世憎小人行之者，以其不顾道理而苟求容进也。若陛下不复考其终始，必以违众忤世为奉公，密行白人为尽节，焉有通人大才而更不能为此邪？诚顾道理而弗为耳。使天下皆背道而趋利，则人主之所最病者，陛下将何乐焉，胡不绝其萌乎！夫先意承旨以求容美，率皆天下浅薄无行义者，其意务在于适人主之心而已，非欲治天下安百姓也。陛下何不试变业而示之，彼岂执其所守以违圣意哉？夫人臣得人主之心，安业也；处尊显之官，荣事也；食千钟之禄，厚实也。

vern.zht: 糾察舉報奸邪作惡之人，本是忠誠的事；然而世人憎惡小人去做這種事，因爲他們不顧道理，只是苟且謀求被容納和進用。如果陛下不再考察事情的始末，就一定會把違背衆人、忤逆世俗當作奉公，把暗中告發別人當作盡節；哪裏有通達事理、才能卓越的人反而做不來這些呢？只不過他們顧念道理而不肯去做罷了。假如天下人都背棄道義而追逐利益，那就是君主最擔憂的事，陛下還有什麼可高興的，爲什麼不斬斷它的萌芽呢！那些預先揣摩君主心意、承奉意旨來求得接納和讚美的人，全都是天下淺薄、沒有品行道義的人；他們的心思只在於迎合君主的心意罷了，並不是想治理天下、安定百姓。陛下爲什麼不試着改變一貫的做法來給他們看看，他們難道會堅持自己原來所守的東西而違背聖意嗎？作爲臣子，得到君主的歡心，是安穩的事業；處在尊貴顯要的官職上，是榮耀的事；享受千鐘的俸祿，是豐厚的實利。
vern.zhs: 纠察举报奸邪作恶之人，本是忠诚的事；然而世人憎恶小人去做这种事，因为他们不顾道理，只是苟且谋求被容纳和进用。如果陛下不再考察事情的始末，就一定会把违背众人、忤逆世俗当作奉公，把暗中告发别人当作尽节；哪里有通达事理、才能卓越的人反而做不来这些呢？只不过他们顾念道理而不肯去做罢了。假如天下人都背弃道义而追逐利益，那就是君主最担忧的事，陛下还有什么可高兴的，为什么不斩断它的萌芽呢！那些预先揣摩君主心意、承奉意旨来求得接纳和赞美的人，全都是天下浅薄、没有品行道义的人；他们的心思只在于迎合君主的心意罢了，并不是想治理天下、安定百姓。陛下为什么不试着改变一贯的做法来给他们看看，他们难道会坚持自己原来所守的东西而违背圣意吗？作为臣子，得到君主的欢心，是安稳的事业；处在尊贵显要的官职上，是荣耀的事；享受千钟的俸禄，是丰厚的实利。

passages.en: To expose and denounce treachery is an act of loyalty. Yet the world despises petty men who do so, because they disregard principle and seek only favour and advancement. If Your Majesty does not examine their conduct from beginning to end, you will inevitably mistake defying the multitude and offending the world for devotion to the public good, and secretly informing against others for the utmost loyalty. Could men of broad understanding and great ability truly be incapable of such things? They refrain only because they have regard for principle. If all under Heaven were to forsake the Way and pursue profit, this would be a ruler's gravest affliction. What pleasure could Your Majesty take in it? Why not suppress it at its first stirrings? Those who anticipate the ruler's wishes and bend to his will in pursuit of favour and praise are most likely shallow men devoid of honour. Their sole concern is to gratify the ruler, not to govern the realm or bring peace to the people. Might Your Majesty not alter your course as a test and make your wishes known to them? Would they then cling to their principles in defiance of your sacred will? For a minister, winning his ruler's favour secures his position; holding a high and eminent office brings honour; and receiving a stipend of a thousand zhong brings abundant wealth.

orig.zht: 人臣雖愚，未有不樂此而喜干迕者也，迫於道，自彊耳。誠以為陛下當憐而佑之，少委任焉，如何反錄昭等傾側之意，而忽若人者乎？今者外有伺隙之寇，內有貧曠之民，陛下當大計天下之損益，政事之得失，誠不可以怠也。」恕在朝八年，其論議亢直，皆此類也。
orig.zhs: 人臣虽愚，未有不乐此而喜干迕者也，迫于道，自彊耳。诚以为陛下当怜而佑之，少委任焉，如何反录昭等倾侧之意，而忽若人者乎？今者外有伺隙之寇，内有贫旷之民，陛下当大计天下之损益，政事之得失，诚不可以怠也。」恕在朝八年，其论议亢直，皆此类也。

vern.zht: 做臣子的即使愚笨，也沒有不樂於如此、反而喜愛冒犯君主的；只是迫於道義，才勉強自己這樣做罷了。我確實認爲陛下應當憐憫並護佑他們，對他們稍加委任；怎麼反而採納廉昭等人傾側不正的意見，卻忽視像這樣的人呢？如今外有窺伺可乘之機的敵寇，內有貧困匱乏的百姓，陛下應當好好考慮天下的利弊、政事的得失，實在不可以懈怠。杜恕在朝爲官八年，他的議論剛正直率，都像這樣。
vern.zhs: 做臣子的即使愚笨，也没有不乐于如此、反而喜爱冒犯君主的；只是迫于道义，才勉强自己这样做罢了。我确实认为陛下应当怜悯并护佑他们，对他们稍加委任；怎么反而采纳廉昭等人倾侧不正的意见，却忽视像这样的人呢？如今外有窥伺可乘之机的敌寇，内有贫困匮乏的百姓，陛下应当好好考虑天下的利弊、政事的得失，实在不可以懈怠。杜恕在朝为官八年，他的议论刚正直率，都像这样。

passages.en: No minister, however foolish, would forgo these benefits and instead go against his ruler's will. He does so only because duty compels him, forcing himself to speak out. He does so only because duty compels him, steeling himself to speak. I truly believe that such men deserve Your Majesty's care and support, and should be granted some measure of trust. How could the subversive designs of Zhao and his associates be heeded, while men of this kind are disregarded? Abroad, enemies watch for an opening; at home, the people are impoverished and neglected. I respectfully hope that Your Majesty will carefully weigh the gains and losses of the realm and the successes and failures of government, and will not permit the slightest remissness." Du Shu served at court for eight years, and his arguments were invariably as uncompromising and forthright as this.

vern.zht: 杜恕出任[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，幾年後轉任[[趙|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=159]][[相|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]，因病離職。後來又被從家中起用爲[[河東|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，一年多後，升[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]爲[[淮|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?water=43]]北[[都督護軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-028]]，又因病離職。杜恕在任職之處，只致力於顧全大體而已；他樹立恩惠仁愛，越來越得到百姓歡心，但比不上杜畿。不久，杜恕被任命爲[[御史中丞|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]]。杜恕在朝廷，因爲不能與當世之人融洽相處，所以屢次出外任職。後來又出任[[幽州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=15]][[刺史|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，加授[[建威將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-136]]，[[使持節|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-envoy-bearing-the-imperial-tally]]，並任[[護烏丸校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-191]]。當時，[[征北將軍|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]]程喜駐紮在[[薊|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=39.90756441&lng=116.38324912&name=Ji]]城，[[尚書|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]袁侃等人告誡杜恕說：“程申伯在先帝的時候，曾在[[青州|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]排擠田國讓。如今您與他都執持節杖，同駐一城，應當深加防備，妥善對待他。”但杜恕不以爲意。
vern.zhs: 杜恕出任[[弘农|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=54]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，几年后转任[[赵|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=159]][[相|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#states-064]]，因病离职。后来又被从家中起用为[[河东|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=57]][[太守|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，一年多后，升[[迁|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]为[[淮|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?water=43]]北[[都督护军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-028]]，又因病离职。杜恕在任职之处，只致力于顾全大体而已；他树立恩惠仁爱，越来越得到百姓欢心，但比不上杜畿。不久，杜恕被任命为[[御史中丞|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]]。杜恕在朝廷，因为不能与当世之人融洽相处，所以屡次出外任职。后来又出任[[幽州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=15]][[刺史|/zh-hans/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]]，加授[[建威将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-136]]，[[使持节|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-envoy-bearing-the-imperial-tally]]，并任[[护乌丸校尉|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-191]]。当时，[[征北将军|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]]程喜驻扎在[[蓟|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?lat=39.90756441&lng=116.38324912&name=Ji]]城，[[尚书|/zh-hans/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]]袁侃等人告诫杜恕说：“程申伯在先帝的时候，曾在[[青州|/zh-hans/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]排挤田国让。如今您与他都执持节杖，同驻一城，应当深加防备，妥善对待他。”但杜恕不以为意。

passages.en: Thereafter, Du Su was [[reinstated|/translations/officials#glossary-reinstate]] as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Hongnong|/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]. After several years, he was [[transferred|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] to serve as [[Principality Chancellor|/translations/officials/regional#states-064]] of [[Zhao State|/maps/map-overall?admin=159]], but resigned owing to illness. He was later recalled as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Hedong|/maps/map-overall?admin=57]]. A year or so later, Du Su was [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]] to [[Protector of the Provincial Army|/translations/officials/military#various-commanders-028]] north of the [[Huai River|/maps/map-overall?water=43]], but again resigned owing to illness. Wherever Du Shu served, he concerned himself chiefly with the larger principles of government. In governing with kindness and winning the people's affection, he did not equal his father, Du [[Ji|/maps/map-overall?lat=39.90756441&lng=116.38324912&name=Ji]]. Before long, Du Su was [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]] [[Deputy Imperial Censor|/translations/officials/departments#censorate-044]]. At court, Du Shu would not conform to the ways of his contemporaries, and was therefore repeatedly assigned to posts outside the capital. He was again sent out as [[Inspector|/translations/officials/regional#provinces-014]] of [[You Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=15]], with the additional titles [[General Who Establishes Might|/translations/officials/military#four-direction--misc-136]], [[Envoy Bearing the Imperial Tally|/translations/officials#glossary-envoy-bearing-the-imperial-tally]] and [[Colonel Protecting the Wuhuan|/translations/officials/military#colonels--commandants-191]]. At the time, Cheng Xi, [[General Who Conquers the North|/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]], was garrisoned at Ji. [[Imperial Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#state-affairs-033]] Yuan Kan and others warned Du Shu: "Under the late emperor, Cheng Shenbo forced Tian Guorang out of [[Qing Province|/maps/map-overall?admin=6]]. You now both bear imperial tallies and are to garrison the same city. You should take great care in dealing with him." Du Shu paid no heed.

《魏略》曰：恕在[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]，寬和有惠愛。及[[遷|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]]，以孟康代恕為[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]。康字公休，[[安平|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=157]]人。黃初中，以於郭后有外屬，并受九親賜拜，遂[[轉|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]]為[[散騎侍郎|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-016]]。是時，散騎皆以高才英儒充其選，而康獨緣妃嬙雜在其間，故于時皆共輕之，號為阿九。康旣無才敏，因在宂官，博讀書傳，後遂有所彈駮，其文義雅而切要，衆人乃更加意。正始中，出為[[弘農|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]，[[領|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-concurrently-oversee]][[典農校尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-242]]。康到官，清己奉職，嘉善而矜不能，省息獄訟，緣民所欲，因而利之。

弘農郡管轄的官吏有兩百多人，春季期間安排他們休假，常常派遣四分之一的官吏放假，承諾的事務從不隔夜未完成。他時常外出巡視，都預先告誡[[督郵|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-055]]、平水，不許讓下屬官員派人探聽伺候，曲意逢迎。又不想煩擾損害官吏百姓。他常常預先告誡官吏士兵，出行時各自帶着鐮刀，在所到之處自己割馬草，不在驛站停留，露天睡在樹下。而且他所帶領的隨從常常不超過十多人。弘農郡地處交通要道。對於那些過往的賓客，如果並非出於公事之需，官府就不提供任何供給；如果是熟悉的老朋友造訪，則自己從家中拿出東西款待。孟康剛被任命時，衆人雖然知道他有志向和度量，因爲他未曾擔任過地方長官，所以不敢保證他能勝任。然而孟康的恩惠和治理才能如此卓著，官吏和百姓都稱讚歌頌他。嘉平末年，他調任[[渤海|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=155]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]]，被徵召入朝擔任[[中書令|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#palace-secretariat-020]]，後來轉任中書[[監|/zh-hant/translations/officials/departments#palace-secretariat-019]]。

The Weilüe / Brief History of Wei states: While Du Shu was in [[Hongnong|/maps/map-overall?admin=54]], he governed with leniency and restraint, and showed benevolent care for the people. When he was [[reassigned|/translations/officials#glossary-reassign]], Meng Kang succeeded him in [[Hongnong|/maps/map-overall?admin=54]]. Meng Kang, courtesy name Gongxiu, was a native of [[Anping|/maps/map-overall?admin=157]]. During the Huangchu era, owing to his Ninefold kinship with Empress Guo, he received imperial bestowments and appointments. He was subsequently [[transferred|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] to [[Cavalier Attendant Gentleman|/translations/officials/departments#chancellery-016]]. At the time, the post was filled by men of outstanding talent and eminent scholars. Meng Kang alone had gained his position through his connection to an imperial consort, so his contemporaries all looked down on him and called him "A-Jiu" (the ninth). Though lacking in talent and quick wit, Meng Kang used the leisure afforded by his sinecure to read widely in the classics and commentaries. He later wrote impeachments and critiques whose arguments were elegant and incisive, and people began to regard him more highly. During the Zhengshi era, Meng Kang was sent out to govern [[Hongnong|/maps/map-overall?admin=54]], [[concurrently|/translations/officials#glossary-concurrently-oversee]] serving as [[Colonel Directing Agriculture|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-iii-242]]. On taking office, Meng Kang lived with integrity and fulfilled his duties faithfully. He commended the worthy and showed compassion to those of limited ability. He reduced litigation and imprisonment, accommodated the people's wishes, and sought thereby to benefit them. 

The commandery employed more than two hundred officials. Each spring, he granted them leave in batches, one quarter at a time. He never left a promise unfulfilled overnight. Whenever he went out on tours of inspection, he instructed the waterways officials and [[Post Marshals|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-055]] in advance not to let subordinate offices send men to watch for his arrival or make elaborate preparations to receive him. Unwilling to burden officials or people, he ordered his attendants to carry sickles whenever they travelled, so that they could cut fodder for the horses themselves. He did not lodge at post stations, but slept in the open beneath the trees, and his retinue never exceeded a dozen or so men. For those passing through the commandery, unless they were on official business, Meng Kang strictly observed the regulations and provided them with nothing. If old friends or acquaintances came to visit, he supplied their needs from his own household. When Meng Kang was first [[appointed|/translations/officials#glossary-formally-appoint]], people recognised his ambition and sound judgement, but as he had never before governed a commandery or province, they doubted his ability. Yet he governed with such benevolence and skill that officials and people alike sang his praises. At the end of the Jiaping era, he was transferred to serve as [[Grand Administrator|/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]] of [[Bohai|/maps/map-overall?admin=155]]. He was later [[recalled|/translations/officials#glossary-summon]] to the capital as [[Director of the Palace Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#palace-secretariat-020]] and subsequently [[promoted|/translations/officials#glossary-transfer]] to [[Supervisor of the Palace Secretariat|/translations/officials/departments#palace-secretariat-019]].

passages.en: Before he had been in office for a year, the son of a Xianbei chieftain bypassed the frontier passes and rode directly to the province with several dozen horsemen. The provincial authorities executed one of his young attendants without submitting a memorial to the throne. Cheng Xi thereupon impeached Du Shu, who was handed over to the [[Commandant of Justice|/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-221]] and sentenced to death. Because his father Du Ji had drowned in devoted service to the state, Du Shu was pardoned, reduced to commoner status, and exiled to [[Zhangwu|/maps/map-overall?lat=38.56299818&lng=117.17636367&name=Zhangwu]] Commandery. This was in the first year of Jiaping. Du Shu was free-spirited and unconcerned with conventions, but he did not know how to guard against trouble, and ultimately brought this disaster upon himself.

《杜氏新書》曰：喜欲恕折節謝己，諷司馬宋權示之以微意。恕荅權書曰：「況示委曲。夫法天下事，以善意相待，無不致快也；以不善意相待，無不致嫌隙也。而議者言，凡人天性皆不善，不當待以善意，更墮其調中。僕得此輩，隨欲歸蹈滄海乘桴耳，不能自諧在其間也。然以年五十二，不見廢棄，頗遭明達君子亮其本心；若不見亮，使人刳心著地，正與數[[斤|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-jin]]肉相似，何足有所明，故終不自解說。

程[[征北|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]]功名宿著，在僕前甚多，有人出征北乎！若令下官事無大小，咨而後行，則非上司彈繩之意；若咨而不從，又非上下相順之宜。故推一心，任一意，直而行之耳。殺胡之事，天下謂之是邪，是僕諧也；呼為非邪，僕自受之，無所怨咎。程征北明之亦善，不明之亦善，諸君子自共為其心耳，不在僕言也。」喜於是遂深文劾恕。

《杜氏新书》曰：喜欲恕折节谢己，讽司马宋权示之以微意。恕荅权书曰：「况示委曲。夫法天下事，以善意相待，无不致快也；以不善意相待，无不致嫌隙也。而议者言，凡人天性皆不善，不当待以善意，更堕其调中。仆得此辈，随欲归蹈沧海乘桴耳，不能自谐在其间也。然以年五十二，不见废弃，颇遭明达君子亮其本心；若不见亮，使人刳心著地，正与数[[斤|/zh-hans/translations/officials#glossary-jin]]肉相似，何足有所明，故终不自解说。

程[[征北|/zh-hans/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]]功名宿著，在仆前甚多，有人出征北乎！若令下官事无大小，咨而后行，则非上司弹绳之意；若咨而不从，又非上下相顺之宜。故推一心，任一意，直而行之耳。杀胡之事，天下谓之是邪，是仆谐也；呼为非邪，仆自受之，无所怨咎。程征北明之亦善，不明之亦善，诸君子自共为其心耳，不在仆言也。」喜于是遂深文劾恕。

《杜氏新書》記載：程喜想讓杜恕屈身向自己道歉，就暗示司馬宋權向杜恕委婉表達這個意思。杜恕給宋權回信說：“何必如此委婉曲折？處理天下的事務，以善意相待，沒有不帶來愉快的；以不善意相待，沒有不產生嫌隙的。我遇到這樣的人，就想隱退到滄海，坐木筏漂流罷了，無法與他們和諧相處。然而我五十二歲了，還沒有被棄置不用，也遇到了不少明達的君子，理解我的本心。如果我的本心不能被理解，就算我把自己的心剖出來放在地上，它也正像幾[[斤|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-jin]]肉一樣，又怎麼能說明什麼呢，所以我始終不自我辯解。

程[[征北|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]]的功名一向顯著，比我高出很多，還有人能超過[[征北|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]]將軍嗎？如果讓我處理事務，無論事情大小。凡事都先向上司諮詢而後再行動，那就不符合上司督察的本意了；如果諮詢了卻不遵從上司的意見，又不符合上下順暢相處的道理，所以我就秉持着自己的本心，按照自己的意願，直接去做事罷了。誅殺胡人這件事，天下人認爲它是對的，那就是我做成的。若說這是錯的，那我自己承擔後果，沒有任何怨恨和責怪。程[[征北|/zh-hant/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]]能理解我也很好，不能理解我也很好，諸位君子各憑本心行事就行了，不在於我的話。程喜於是就羅織罪名彈劾恕。

The New Book of Du Clan states: Cheng Xi wanted Du Shu to humble himself deferentially and apologise, and prompted Major Song Quan to convey his wishes discreetly. Du Shu replied to Song Quan in a letter: "What of the subtle intentions that lay beneath the surface? In dealing with the affairs of the world, goodwill always brings satisfaction, while ill will invariably breeds resentment. Some critics say that human nature is wholly bad, and that one should not treat others with goodwill, lest one fall prey to their schemes. If I had to live among such men, I would rather take to the blue sea on a raft, for I could never accommodate myself to them. Yet at fifty-two I have not been cast aside, and have often met discerning gentlemen who understood my true intentions. If no one understood me, even cutting out my heart and laying it on the ground would reveal no more than several [[Jin|/translations/officials#glossary-jin]] of flesh. What could that prove? I have therefore never sought to explain myself. 

The [[General Who Conquers the North|/translations/officials/military#conquering--garrisoning-067]] Cheng Xi has long enjoyed distinguished merit and renown, far surpassing my own. Who could surpass the General? If I, as his subordinate, were required to consult him before acting in every matter, great or small, that would not accord with his duty as a superior to impeach wrongdoing. If I consulted him but did not follow his direction, that too would disrupt the harmony between us. I therefore follow my own convictions, rely on my own judgement, and act forthrightly. As for the killing of the Hu, if the people of the realm judge that I acted rightly, then I accomplished the deed; if they say that I acted wrongly, I shall bear the consequences myself and blame no one else. It matters little whether Cheng, General Who Conquers the North, understands the matter or not. The various gentlemen will judge it for themselves; it does not depend on anything I might say." Cheng Xi thereupon drew up a harsh indictment against Du Shu.

orig.zht: 初，恕從[[趙|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=159]]郡還，[[陳留|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?admin=39]]阮武亦從[[清河|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=36.91514604&lng=115.75902922&name=Qinghe]][[太守|/zh-hant/translations/officials/regional#commanderies-039]][[徵|/zh-hant/translations/officials#glossary-summon]]，俱自薄[[廷尉|/zh-hant/translations/officials/ministers#-nine-ministers-ii-221]]。謂恕曰：「相觀才性可以由公道而持之不厲，器能可以處大官而求之不順，才學可以述古今而志之不一，此所謂有其才而無其用。今向閑暇，可試潛思，成一家言。」在[[章武|/zh-hant/maps/map-overall?lat=38.56299818&lng=117.17636367&name=Zhangwu]]，遂著體論八節。又著興性論一篇，蓋興於為己也。四年，卒於徙所。
